By securing majorities in both congressional chambers, Democrats possess the legislative authority to obstruct Trump's political agenda and initiate investigations into suspected corruption. Voter discontent was heavily fueled by widespread frustration regarding escalating living expenses, trade tariffs, and the military campaign against Iran, which drove up fuel prices and intensified overall dissatisfaction with the president.

Meanwhile, officials in Tehran welcomed the outcome of the American elections. Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, the Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, expressed approval of the results on Wednesday through a post on the social media platform X, stating that Americans had rejected warfare and that Tehran supported that message. The sweeping Democratic victories included flipping Senate seats in at least six states, notably traditional Republican strongholds such as Texas, Kansas, and South Carolina.

stories.title: Islamabad High Court Sets Hearing for Imran and Bushra's £190m Case Appeals
stories.summary:
The Islamabad High Court has scheduled the hearing for appeals filed by Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf founder Imran Khan and his wife, Bushra Bibi, against their convictions in the £190 million case for November 10. A division bench consisting of Chief Justice Sardar Muhammad Sarfraz Dogar and Justice Muhammad Asif will preside over the proceedings to evaluate arguments from the convicts' legal counsel challenging their prison sentences.

The upcoming hearing follows a previous adjournment requested by Imran's lawyer, Barrister Salman Safdar, before the court formally took up the matter. In January 2025, an Islamabad accountability court had sentenced Imran to 14 years and Bushra to seven years in prison following a reference filed by the National Accountability Bureau.

The £190 million case centers around allegations involving the Al-Qadir Trust, a welfare organization established in 2018 that operates a university outside Islamabad. Government allegations claim the trust served as a front to receive millions of dollars in land from a real estate tycoon in exchange for the former prime minister's administration using repatriated funds from the United Kingdom to pay off the businessman's fines instead of depositing the money into the national exchequer.

Imran Khan has consistently denied all allegations of wrongdoing, maintaining that neither he nor his spouse derived any personal financial benefit from the trust or the associated financial transactions.

stories.title: امریکہ کے وسط مدتی انتخابات میں ڈیموکریٹس کی برتری، ٹرمپ کا تعاون کا اعلان
stories.summary:
امریکہ کے وسط مدتی انتخابات میں ڈیموکریٹس کے لیے حوصلہ افزا نتائج سامنے آئے ہیں اور پیش گوئی کی جا رہی ہے کہ وہ سینیٹ اور ایوانِ نمائندگان دونوں میں اکثریت حاصل کر لیں گے۔ اس صورتحال کے بعد صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے غیر متوقع طور پر مفاہمتی انداز اپناتے ہوئے ڈیموکریٹس کے ساتھ مل کر کام کرنے کی آمادگی ظاہر کی ہے۔

ٹرمپ نے پولیٹیکو سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ وہ ڈیموکریٹس کے ساتھ مل کر کام کریں گے تاکہ ملک کے معاملات بہتر انداز میں آگے بڑھ سکیں۔ تاہم دوسری جانب وہ اپنے صدارتی اختیارات اور ویٹو کے حق کے استعمال کے بھی اشارے دے چکے ہیں تاکہ ڈیموکریٹس کی قانون سازی میں توازن رکھا جا سکے۔

مشیگن میں عبدل السیّد سینیٹ کے لیے منتخب ہونے والے پہلے مسلمان مرد بن گئے ہیں، جسے ووٹرز نے ایک تاریخی سنگِ میل قرار دیا ہے۔ دریں اثنا، الاسکا میں سینیٹ کی ایک نشست پر مقابلہ انتہائی سخت ہے جہاں موجودہ سینیٹر ڈین سلیوان اور ڈیموکریٹ میری پیلٹولا کے درمیان مقابلہ جاری ہے، اور اس نشست پر دو ہم نام امیدواروں کی موجودگی پر عدالت میں درخواست بھی دائر کی گئی تھی۔

ایرانی پارلیمنٹ کے سپیکر محمد باقر قالیباف نے بھی امریکی انتخابات پر تبصرہ کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ امریکیوں نے جنگ کو مسترد کیا ہے۔ دریں اثنا لاس اینڈ میں میئر کے انتخاب کے لیے کیرن بیس اور نتھیا رامن کے درمیان کانٹے کا مقابلہ جاری ہے جبکہ حتمی نتائج میں کچھ وقت لگ سکتا ہے۔

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Highlights Middle East Peace Efforts and Domestic Relief
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif stated that Pakistan is maintaining its active diplomatic role in seeking peace restoration in the Middle East amidst rising international fuel prices. During a federal cabinet meeting on November 4, the premier pointed out that global oil costs had surged heavily due to regional instability, recalling recent engagements with Tehran and other regional authorities, as well as efforts tied to the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement.

Addressing domestic economic pressures, PM Shehbaz mentioned that a planned Rs15 fuel price hike scheduled for Friday was averted after Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik engaged with local refineries to absorb the cost through their windfall profits, ensuring ordinary citizens are protected from the burden. He added that the fuel subsidy initiative, rolled out in September, will remain active until the end of December, noting that Rs28 billion has been spent transparently under Intelligence Bureau monitoring.

Regarding the liquefied petroleum gas sector, the prime minister declared that the influence of the LPG mafia has ended through transparent importation, competitive lot auctions, and consumer subsidies. Furthermore, he announced a finalized Rs160 billion development and security package for Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, emphasizing that counterterrorism remains a paramount priority alongside winter energy preparations despite maritime route disruptions.

The measures are vital for maintaining economic stability, ensuring public welfare, and addressing regional security concerns as Pakistan navigates complex geopolitical and domestic challenges.

stories.title: پبلک اکاؤنٹس کمیٹی کا وزارت خارجہ میں کروڑوں کی مالی بے ضابطگیوں کا انکشاف
stories.summary:
قومی اسمبلی کی پبلک اکاؤنٹس کمیٹی (پی اے سی) کے اجلاس میں مالی سال 24-2023 کے دوران وزارت خارجہ میں کروڑوں روپے کی مبینہ مالی بے ضابطگیوں کا انکشاف ہوا ہے۔ کمیٹی کے اجلاس کی صدارت نوید قمر نے کی، جس میں آسٹریا اور بلغاریہ کے پاکستانی سفارت خانوں میں اکاؤنٹنٹس کی جانب سے رقم کی خورد برد کے معاملات زیر غور لائے گئے۔

آڈٹ حکام نے کمیٹی کو بتایا کہ آسٹریا میں پاکستانی سفارت خانے کے اکاؤنٹنٹ سلمان قریشی نے مبینہ طور پر 16 کروڑ 56 لاکھ روپے یعنی ایک لاکھ 70 ہزار یورو خرد برد کیے اور رقم ذاتی اکاؤنٹس میں منتقل کی۔ سیکریٹری خارجہ عاصم افتخار نے بتایا کہ ملزم کو فوری برطرف کر کے مقدمہ درج کرا دیا گیا تھا اور وہ ضمانت پر رہا ہے۔ چیئرمین پی اے سی نے چھ سال گزرنے کے باوجود صرف ایف آئی آرز درج ہونے پر ایف آئی اے کی کارکردگی کو انتہائی مایوس کن قرار دیا۔

اجلاس میں بلغاریہ میں پاکستانی سفارت خانے کے اکاؤنٹنٹ کی جانب سے 2 کروڑ 90 لاکھ روپے کی خورد برد کا معاملہ بھی سامنے آیا۔ حکام نے بتایا کہ انکوائری کمیٹی کفایت شعاری اقدامات کی وجہ سے بیرون ملک نہیں جا سکی، جس پر کمیٹی نے انکوائری ٹیم کو بیرون ملک جانے کی اجازت دینے کی سفارش کی۔ مزید برآں، برلن میں پاکستانی سفارت خانے کی جانب سے ایچ ای سی کے اسکالرشپ فنڈ سے 10 کروڑ روپے قرض لینے اور ابوظہبی میں نجی کمیونٹی اسکول کو فنڈز کی ادائیگی کے معاملات پر بھی تفصیلی بحث کی گئی۔

سیکریٹری خارجہ نے وزارت کے افسران کے جوابات سے عدم اطمینان کا اظہار کیا۔ پی اے سی نے وزارت خارجہ کے مالی نظم و نسق پر گہری تشویش ظاہر کرتے ہوئے مستقبل میں ایسے واقعات کی روک تھام کے لیے واضح قواعد و ضوابط بنانے کی سخت ہدایت کی۔

stories.title: عبدل السید مشیگن سے سینیٹ کے پہلے مسلمان رکن منتخب
stories.summary:
امریکہ میں منگل کو ہونے والے انتخابات کے بعد مشیگن ریاست سے ڈیموکریٹک پارٹی کے امیدوار عبدل السید کامیاب ہو کر پہلے مسلمان سینیٹر بن گئے ہیں۔ حامیوں سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے اپنی کامیابی کو سراہا اور کہا کہ وہ ریاست مشیگن کی خدمت کے منتظر ہیں۔

انتخابی مہم کے آخری دنوں میں انہیں اپنی ہی جماعت کی رکن ہیلی سٹیونز کی جانب سے چیلنج کا سامنا کرنا پڑا جنہوں نے ریپبلکن امیدوار مائیک راجرز کی حمایت کی تھی۔ تاہم تمام تر چیلنجز کے باوجود السید انتخابات میں کامیابی حاصل کرنے میں کامیاب رہے۔

1984 میں ڈیٹرائٹ کے مضافات میں پیدا ہونے والے عبدل السید نے یونیورسٹی آف مشیگن اور کولمبیا یونیورسٹی سے طب کی تعلیم حاصل کی۔ وہ 2015 میں ڈیٹرائٹ سٹی کے محکمہ صحت کے ایگزیکٹو سربراہ رہے ہیں اور 2018 میں مشیگن کے گورنر کے پرائمری انتخابات میں حصہ لے چکے ہیں۔

ان کی انتخابی مہم صحت، معاشی عدم مساوات اور انتخابی اصلاحات کے گرد گھومتی تھی۔ صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے ان کی مہم کے دوران ان پر شدید تنقید کی اور انہیں کمیونسٹ قرار دیا جبکہ السید نے ان تمام الزامات کی تردید کی۔

stories.title: Abdul El-Sayed Wins Michigan Senate Seat as First Muslim US Senator
stories.summary:
Abdul El-Sayed won election to the United States Senate by defeating Republican candidate Mike Rogers in Michigan, marking a historic milestone as the first Muslim ever elected to the US Senate. At 42 years old, the Egyptian-American physician, public health expert, and progressive Democrat previously directed the Wayne County Department of Health in Michigan and ran for governor in 2018. His campaign focused on progressive issues including Medicare for All healthcare reform, economic inequality, reducing wealthy donor influence, and cutting overseas military spending.

The victory carries profound significance due to the intense political and Islamophobic scrutiny El-Sayed faced during his campaign. Donald Trump repeatedly attacked him by labeling him a 'jihadist' and invoking the September 11 attacks to question his national loyalty, while other Republicans falsely linked him to the Muslim Brotherhood. El-Sayed rejected these accusations, affirmed his commitment to the US Constitution, and maintained that American democracy must embrace citizens of all backgrounds. His grassroots movement successfully overcame heavy opposition spending, including funding from pro-Israel lobbying groups during the Democratic primary.

For millions of American Muslims, El-Sayed's election provides vital political representation, transforming community members and voters into national lawmakers and decision-makers. It challenges long-standing prejudices that attempt to paint Muslims as security threats or outsiders to American public life. Internationally, his win resonates deeply across the Middle East, North Africa, and South Asia, drawing attention due to his outspoken criticism of unconditional US military aid to Israel.

While his victory does not instantly alter Washington foreign policy or eradicate domestic Islamophobia, it fundamentally reshapes the conversation surrounding religious diversity and political inclusion in American democracy.

stories.title: Virat Kohli's Brilliant Half-Century Leads India to Victory Over New Zealand
stories.summary:
Virat Kohli hit an unbeaten 74 to guide India to a five-wicket triumph against New Zealand in the opening one-day international at Eden Park in Auckland on Wednesday. Turning 38 on Thursday, the veteran batsman struck his 80th ODI fifty from just 35 balls on a quick, bouncy pitch where other batters struggled, finishing his 51-ball knock with 13 fours and a six. India successfully chased a Duckworth-Lewis-adjusted target of 143 runs in 32 overs with 56 balls remaining, claiming a 1-0 lead in the five-match series.

New Zealand won the toss and batted first after rain caused a brief ten-minute delay to the start. The hosts were restricted to 185 all out in the 41st innings, with Tim Seifert top-scoring with 38 after replacing the concussed Devon Conway. Glenn Phillips contributed 30 runs, Daryl Mitchell added 28, and Blair Tickner made a quick 34 from 23 deliveries at the end of the innings. Indian bowlers Arshdeep Singh and Gurnoor Brar performed exceptionally, capturing 4-70 and 3-44 respectively to dismantle the New Zealand batting lineup.

India's chase suffered an early setback when captain Rohit Sharma was dismissed for a duck in the first over. However, Kohli anchored the innings alongside Shubman Gill, who contributed 37 runs from 56 balls during a crucial 113-run partnership. Rain interruptions temporarily halted play during the 11th and 12th overs before revised targets were established. Jacob Duffy picked up three wickets for New Zealand, but Kohli's aggressive strokeplay swiftly sealed the win.

The victory gives India an early advantage in the five-game series, with the second match scheduled to take place in Wellington on Saturday.

stories.title: Gold Prices Surge Sharply Across Pakistan Markets
stories.summary:
Gold prices recorded a significant increase across Pakistan on Wednesday, according to figures released by the All Pakistan Sarafa Gems and Jewellers Association. The cost of 24 karat per tola experienced a surge of Rs13,900, bringing the rate to Rs426,003. Additionally, the price for 22 karat per 10 grams went up by Rs11,917 to reach Rs365,257.

On the global front, gold rose by approximately $139 to settle around $4,035 per ounce. This upward movement contrasts with a previous gain of Rs2,400 earlier in the week, though prices remain well below the peaks seen in March 2026 when the metal traded near Rs541,000 per tola. Meanwhile, silver showed more volatility, dropping on Tuesday in response to softer international rates and varying industrial demand.

Market participants note that domestic bullion prices remain tightly linked to international rates and the exchange rate between the Pakistani rupee and the US dollar. Local price movements are often driven by a weaker global dollar, while factors like wedding-season demand and investments continue to influence intra-day quotations despite high absolute price levels.

Looking ahead, dealers and analysts are closely monitoring forthcoming US economic data, Federal Reserve policies, and global geopolitical developments for future market directions. Following recent rallies in gold and a decline in silver, the market remains in a period of consolidation after experiencing substantial price swings throughout 2026.

stories.title: Union Town in Lahore Achieves Major Development Milestones
stories.summary:
Union Town, an LDA-approved master-planned community developed by Union Developers (Pvt.) Limited in Lahore, has completed major infrastructure works within six months of record-breaking progress. The project features residential and commercial plots that are now fully developed and ready for immediate possession for interested buyers.

The community benefits from a strategic location in urban Lahore with triple access points via Kadir Topbas Chowk, Abdul Sattar Edhi Road, and Khayaban-e-Jinnah. Key nearby landmarks include the M2 Motorway and Shaukat Khanum Hospital, which are reachable within minutes, alongside the Lahore Ring Road and Canal Road.

A central feature of the development is the 150-feet-wide Pine Avenue, operating as a signal-free corridor running directly through the community to connect every block. Completed infrastructure works across the property include internal road networks, streetlights, an installed sewerage system, and community parks.

According to Naeem Ahmad Malik, CEO of Union Developers, the project embodies the company's vision of delivering a quality lifestyle through modern infrastructure and thoughtful planning. The development offers residential plots ranging from 3 to 20 Marla and commercial plots from 2 to 10 Marla to accommodate diverse lifestyle and investment needs.

stories.title: Trump-Backed Senate Candidates Suffer Major Defeats in Midterm Elections
stories.summary:
President Donald Trump's hand-picked Republican Senate candidates faced widespread defeats in the midterm elections, handing control of Congress to the Democrats and revealing the limits of the president's political influence. Trump had urged voters to view him as being on the ballot and intervened in key primaries to favor loyalists over established candidates with stronger local networks. High inflation driven by tariffs and the ongoing war in Iran contributed to voter frustration, while Reuters/Ipsos polls indicated Trump's popularity had dropped below levels seen after the January 6, 2021, Capitol attack.

In South Carolina, a state Trump won in 2024 and which had not elected a Democratic senator since 1998, Trump-backed Darline Graham lost to Democrat Annie Andrews. In North Carolina, former national Republican campaign official Michael Whatley was defeated by former Democratic Governor Roy Cooper after incumbent Republican Senator Thom Tillis declined to seek re-election following a public dispute with Trump. Independent analysts noted that Trump's intervention in the Texas primary cost Republicans a safe seat, as scandal-plagued Attorney General Ken Paxton lost to Democrat James Talarico instead of safer primary choice Senator John Cornyn. Meanwhile, former Representative Mike Rogers lost in Michigan to Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, who made history as the first Muslim elected to the United States Senate.

Strategists and former officials offered mixed reactions to the outcome, with veteran Republican strategist Doug Heye describing the results as a "Trump Quake" driven by economic and foreign policy concerns. Former North Carolina Governor Pat McCrory argued that the president's primary interventions fractured state Republican parties and eroded his connection with working-class voters. Despite internal White House polling from six weeks prior indicating projected losses in both the House and Senate, Trump defended his actions on social media, writing that he would have won in a landslide if he had personally been on the ballot.

White House officials defended the administration's efforts, noting that the president actively campaigned nationwide to salvage Republican chances after seeing grim internal polling data. Independent observers like American University professor Thomas Kahn emphasized that the strategic miscalculations in states like Texas and North Carolina directly handed secure seats over to the Democratic Party. The sweeping Democratic victories ultimately reshaped the congressional landscape and triggered intense debate within the Republican Party regarding Trump's ongoing role and political strategy moving forward.

stories.title: Scott Parker Appointed as New West Ham Manager
stories.summary:
Scott Parker has returned to West Ham United as the club's new manager on Wednesday, signing a two-and-a-half-year contract. The 46-year-old former England midfielder aims to lead the Championship side back to the Premier League following their recent relegation.

During his playing career, Parker made 129 appearances for West Ham between 2007 and 2011, serving as team captain. As a manager, he brings extensive experience in securing promotion from the second tier, having previously guided Fulham in 2020, Bournemouth in 2022, and Burnley in 2025 to the top flight.

Parker steps into the role to replace Nuno Espirito Santo, who was dismissed after consecutive defeats left the club in eighth place in the standings. Nuno had taken charge of a struggling West Ham squad in September 2025 but was unable to prevent the team's first relegation since 2011.

Expressing pride in his return, Parker described the opportunity as a chance to lead the club back to the Premier League. He most recently managed Burnley, departing by mutual consent in April shortly after the club's relegation back to the Championship.

stories.title: UN Women Honours Seventeen Businesses and Leaders at Pakistan WEPs Awards
stories.summary:
UN Women has recognized 17 businesses and leaders for advancing gender equality during the 2026 Women’s Empowerment Principles Awards in Pakistan. Selected from 52 nationwide applicants across seven categories, the honorees include major corporations as well as small and medium-sized enterprises. The event was organized by UN Women Pakistan in collaboration with Derien and Soorty, with Geo News serving as the media partner.

During the ceremony, UN Women Pakistan Country Representative Jamshed M. Kazi emphasized that business success is measured by the lives transformed and the futures made possible when women lead without barriers. Sindh Local Government Minister Syed Nasir Hussain Shah, the chief guest, noted that women's economic participation is vital for national progress. Nishat Fatima, CEO of South Air and keynote speaker, added that empowering women strengthens organizations and drives innovation.

The awards celebrated inclusive leadership, gender-responsive business practices, inclusive procurement, and the role of technology and artificial intelligence in promoting gender equality. National winners will be considered for the regional 2026 Asia-Pacific WEPs Awards, which will be broadcast on December 1, 2026, via the UN Women Asia-Pacific YouTube channel.

Marking the first national WEPs ceremony in Pakistan, the event underscored the importance of moving beyond paper commitments to real workplace and market changes. UN Women, the leading United Nations entity for gender equality, aims to transform laws, institutions, and social norms to close the global gender gap.

stories.title: SSGC Releases Winter Gas Supply Schedule for Consumers
stories.summary:
The Sui Southern Gas Company (SSGC) has officially announced its gas supply schedule for the winter season, establishing fixed time slots to prioritize domestic consumers during cooking hours. The measures follow directives issued by the Government of Pakistan to manage utility challenges.

Under the newly released schedule, gas will be supplied to households during three specific periods each day. Supplies will be available for breakfast from 6:30 am to 9:00 am, for lunch from 12:00 pm to 2:30 pm, and for dinner from 6:00 pm to 9:00 pm.

SSGC operates as one of the primary gas utilities in Pakistan, managing transmission and distribution across the Sindh and Balochistan provinces. The company maintains an extensive network of approximately 55,000 kilometres, providing natural gas to 3.2 million customers, which includes 4,500 industrial clients.

Historically, the utility has encountered significant operational hurdles. These challenges include unfinalized financial statements spanning several years, accumulating corporate losses, high levels of Unaccounted-for-Gas line losses, and mounting inter-enterprise liabilities that contribute to sector-wide circular debt.

stories.title: Indian Rupee Closes Slightly Higher as US Midterm Results Weaken Dollar
stories.summary:
The Indian currency concluded trading on Wednesday with a modest gain, moving to 94.64 per dollar compared to the prior session's finish of 94.74. This upward movement was supported by a softer American dollar and decreased oil costs as market participants evaluated the outcome of the United States midterm elections. The greenback's index dropped 0.4 percent to land at 101.3, with strong performances from the euro, Swiss franc, and sterling. During early trading hours, the rupee reached a two-week peak before paring gains due to increased interbank and importer dollar purchases near the 94.50 threshold.

Political developments in the US saw Democrats secure majorities in both the House and Senate following sweeping electoral wins across Republican strongholds, delivering a severe rebuke to President Donald Trump. Despite the rupee's temporary boost, a Reuters survey indicates that expectations for depreciation in the South Asian currency remain unchanged. Analysts project that the unit will surrender its recent advances and decline in the coming months amid a volatile external environment, ongoing high oil prices, and weak portfolio inflows.

The Reserve Bank of India has implemented multiple measures since the onset of the Iran conflict, including heavy intervention, restricted currency markets, higher interest rates, and raising roughly $143 billion via a borrowing and deposit scheme. According to financial firm Natixis, these actions successfully averted a disorderly collapse and provided temporary relief, but they fail to tackle the underlying causes of weakness. The note emphasized that central banks cannot manufacture export capacity, energy independence, or manufacturing investment, asserting that only structural reforms can address these fundamental issues.

stories.title: پنجاب کو تین یا چار انتظامی صوبوں میں تقسیم کیا جائے، خالد اصغر گھرال
stories.summary:
پاکستان مسلم لیگ (ق) کے رہنما اور پنجاب اسمبلی کے رکن چوہدری خالد اصغر گھرال نے گلاسگو میں ایک عشائیے سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ بہتر حکمرانی اور عوامی مسائل کے حل کے لیے چھوٹے صوبوں کا قیام ضروری ہو چکا ہے۔ انہوں نے تجویز دی کہ تیرہ کروڑ سے زائد آبادی والے صوبہ پنجاب کو تین یا چار انتظامی حصوں میں بانٹ دیا جائے۔

تقریب کے دوران گفتگو کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے مولانا فضل الرحمٰن کی موجودہ سیاسی سرگرمیوں پر تنقید کی اور انہیں افسوس ناک قرار دیا۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ بلوچستان اور خیبر پختون خوا میں سیکیورٹی کی خراب صورتِ حال کی وجہ سے تمام سیاسی جماعتوں کو قومی مفاد میں مشترکہ مؤقف اپنانا چاہیے اور ریاستی اداروں کا ساتھ دینا چاہیے۔

بیرونِ ملک مقیم پاکستانیوں کی خدمات کو سراہتے ہوئے انہوں نے کہا کہ وہ اپنی محنت اور دیانت کی بدولت دنیا بھر میں نمایاں مقام رکھتے ہیں اور سالانہ چالیس ارب ڈالرز سے زائد زرمبادلہ پاکستان بھیج کر معیشت کو سہارا دیتے ہیں۔ اس موقع پر چوہدری احسن گھرال نے بھی اظہارِ خیال کیا کہ وطن واپسی پر سمندر پار پاکستانیوں کو ایئر پورٹس پر ہراسانی کا سامنا کرنا پڑتا ہے۔

تقریب کے میزبان چوہدری طارق گوندل نے کہا کہ حکومت کو اوورسیز پاکستانیوں کو تحفظ دینا چاہیے تاکہ وہ اربوں ڈالرز کی سرمایہ کاری کر سکیں۔ چوہدری خالد اصغر گھرال نے شرکاء کو یقین دلایا کہ وہ تارکینِ وطن کے مسائل متعلقہ حکام کے سامنے اٹھائیں گے تاکہ ان کا ازالہ ممکن ہو سکے۔

stories.title: Shaza Fatima Khawaja Wins Prestigious Global Industry Champion of the Year Award
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Information Technology Shaza Fatima Khawaja has been honored with the international 'Industry Champion of the Year 2026' title at the Fastmode Awards 2026. She secured the global accolade after competing against more than 500 corporations spanning over 60 countries. This distinction is awarded annually to just a single leader worldwide, highlighting notable progress within Pakistan's information technology and IT-enabled services sector under her administration.

Under Khawaja's leadership, the nation's IT and ITeS exports reached a record-breaking $4.6 billion throughout the 2025-26 fiscal year. Furthermore, the sector achieved a trade surplus amounting to $3.9 billion, making it the top-performing segment among all services sectors in the country. Freelance export revenues totaled $1.76 billion, while active and registered freelancers surpassed 2.37 million. Additional milestones included completing Pakistan's largest-ever 5G and Next Generation Mobile Services spectrum auction in March 2026, expanding total available spectrum to 750 megahertz, and becoming the first Asian nation to entirely eliminate right-of-way charges for faster fibre-optic expansion.

Additional digital achievements involve Google registering and establishing its inaugural office in Pakistan alongside a local assembly line capable of producing 600,000 Chromebooks annually. The DigiSkills initiative delivered free digital training to over 4.5 million young individuals, including 800,000 women. Additionally, the GSMA reported a drop in the mobile internet gender gap from 38 percent to 8 percent, and the country climbed 27 places in the International Telecommunication Union's ICT Development Index 2026.

stories.title: Sri Lanka Declares at 223-7 Following Solid Fifties Against PCB Patron’s XI
stories.summary:
Sri Lanka closed their first innings at 223-7 declared during a three-day warm-up match against the PCB Patron’s XI at the Oval Ground in Islamabad on Wednesday. Winning the toss and opting to bat first, the visiting side struggled early on as opposing pacers effectively utilized morning moisture to trouble the top order. Quick breakthroughs by Saqib Khan and Mohammad Salman reduced Sri Lanka to 40-3, removing openers Pasindu Sooriyabandara, Dinesh Chandimal, and Dhananjaya De Silva in rapid succession.

In response to the early collapse, captain Kusal Mendis and opening batsman Lahiru Udara steadied the innings through a crucial 90-run partnership for the fourth wicket. Udara anchored the recovery with a disciplined knock of 65 runs from 105 balls, hitting seven fours and three sixes before being caught off his own bowling by Ali Shabir. Shabir quickly claimed another wicket by dismissing Sunal Dinusha for 10, leaving the visitors struggling at 153-5.

Following the dismissal of Udara and Dinusha, Kusal Mendis found reliable support in Anjala Bandara, who contributed a valuable 45-run partnership for the sixth wicket. Kusal eventually fell to fast bowler Ubaid Shah after scoring a team-high 66 runs from 72 balls, featuring 11 boundaries. Following Kusal's dismissal, Bandara continued to anchor the crease and finished unbeaten on 33 runs from 61 balls, prompting the Sri Lankan captain to declare the innings at 223-7 to give his bowling attack an opportunity before stumps.

For the PCB Patron’s XI, Saqib Khan, Mohammad Salman, and Ali Shabir each claimed two wickets. In reply, the home side reached 43-2 in 15 overs before stumps, with Azan Awais batting on 19 and Mohammad Taha on 16 after early dismissals by Dilshan Madushanka and Rathnayake. The fixture serves as final preparation for Sri Lanka ahead of the upcoming two-match Test series against Pakistan, which is scheduled to commence at the Rawalidpindi Cricket Stadium on November 9.

stories.title: سوئی سدرن نے کراچی میں موسم سرما کے لیے گیس شیڈول جاری کر دیا
stories.summary: سوئی سدرن گیس کمپنی نے کراچی کے گھریلو صارفین کے لیے موسم سرما کے دوران گیس لوڈشیڈنگ کا نیا شیڈول جاری کر دیا ہے۔ اس نئے شیڈول کے تحت صارفین کو چوبیس گھنٹوں میں صرف تین مخصوص اوقات کار کے دوران ہی گیس کی فراہمی ممکن ہو سکے گی۔ کمپنی کے اعلامیے کے مطابق صبح کے وقت ناشتے کی تیاری کے لیے ساڑھے چھ بجے سے نو بجے تک، دوپہر کے کھانے کے لیے بارہ بجے سے ڈھائی بجے تک، اور شام کے وقت رات کے کھانے کے لیے چھ بجے سے نو بجے تک گیس مہیا کی جائے گی۔ شہریوں کو ہدایت دی گئی ہے کہ وہ اپنے روزمرہ کے کھانے پینے کے امور کو انہی مقررہ اوقات کے مطابق ترتیب دیں۔ کسی بھی قسم کی شکایت یا معلومات کے حصول کے لیے صارفین ہیلپ لائن نمبر 1199 پر رابطہ کر سکتے ہیں یا پھر سرکاری ویب سائٹ سے رجوع کر سکتے ہیں۔ دوسری طرف، عوام کی جانب سے اس شیڈول پر شدید تحفظات کا اظہار کیا گیا ہے۔ متاثرہ شہریوں کا کہنا ہے کہ کاغذی حد تک جاری ہونے والا یہ شیڈول عملی طور پر نافذ نہیں ہوتا، کیونکہ مقررہ وقت سے پہلے ہی گیس کی فراہمی معطل کر دی جاتی ہے اور گیس آنے کے وقت بھی تاخیر برتی جاتی ہے۔ اس صورتحال کی وجہ سے بیشتر علاقوں میں صبح ساڑھے چھ بجے کے بجائے سات بجے کے بعد گیس آتی ہے اور نو بجے سے پہلے ہی غائب ہو جاتی ہے، اور یہی بے قاعدگی دوپہر اور رات کے اوقات میں بھی برقرار رہتی ہے۔ اس بے قاعدگی کی وجہ سے بچوں کا ناشتہ، اسکول کا ٹفن اور رات کا کھانا بنانے کے معاملات سخت متاثر ہو رہے ہیں۔ ہر گھرانے کے لیے مہنگے ایل پی جی سلنڈر خریدنا ممکن نہیں ہے، اس لیے شہریوں نے سوئی سدرن گیس کمپنی سے پرزور مطالبہ کیا ہے کہ صرف شیڈول جاری کرنے پر اکتفا نہ کیا جائے بلکہ اس پر سختی سے عملدرآمد کو بھی یقینی بنایا جائے، اور جن علاقوں میں پریشر کم ہے یا گیس تاخیر سے پہنچتی ہے وہاں فوری بنیادوں پر ضروری اقدامات اٹھائے جائیں۔

stories.title: UK Supreme Court Hears Challenge Against Palestine Action Terrorist Designation
stories.summary:
A co-founder of Palestine Action appeared at the UK Supreme Court to contest the British government's classification of the campaign group as a terrorist organisation. Lawyers representing Huda Ammori argued that the proscription was disproportionate and misused counter-terrorism laws, pointing out that government officials had previously assessed that only three out of 385 actions over a five-year period met terrorism definitions. 

The British government officially proscribed the group last year following a series of escalating disruptions primarily aimed at defense companies. These incidents culminated in a break-in at the Royal Air Force's Brize Norton air base that resulted in damage to two aircraft, as well as a 2024 raid targeting Israeli defense firm Elbit Systems that caused an estimated £1 million ($1.35 million) in property damage. The Home Office maintained that these actions involved weapons and violence against police officers and security staff, including an incident where an officer suffered a spinal injury from a sledgehammer. 

The government ban has drawn substantial pushback from civil liberties organizations and public figures, including Irish novelist Sally Rooney, whose books were pulled from sale in Britain over royalty donations to the group. Home Office data indicates that more than 3,600 arrests linked to Palestine Action occurred between July 2025 and June, accounting for over a third of all UK terrorism arrests since 9/11. Following subsequent demonstrations outside the US embassy in London and outside the Supreme Court, the total number of arrests has now surpassed 4,000. 

Founded in 2020, Palestine Action frequently utilized obstruction, property occupation, window smashing, and graffiti against businesses tied to arms supplies for Israel. Legal arguments on Wednesday referenced historical movements like early 20th-century suffragettes to debate the extremity of the group's tactics. While London's High Court initially declared the ban unlawful, the Court of Appeal reversed that ruling in June. Internationally, the United States also designated Palestine Action as a terrorist group in August, following protests that targeted President Donald Trump's Scottish golf resort.

stories.title: کراچی کے جناح اسپتال میں ریبیز سے بارہ سالہ بچہ جاں بحق
stories.summary: کراچی کے جناح اسپتال میں ریبیز کے مرض میں مبتلا بارہ سالہ بچہ دورانِ علاج دم توڑ گیا ہے۔ اس تازہ ترین واقعے کے بعد رواں سال کے دوران سندھ بھر میں ریبیز کے مرض سے جاں بحق ہونے والے افراد کی مجموعی تعداد اکتالیس ہو چکی ہے۔ اسپتال ذرائع کے مطابق اس بدقسمت بچے کا تعلق بلوچستان کے ضلع جھل مگسی سے تھا، جسے تقریباً ایک ماہ قبل ایک آوارہ کتے نے چہرے اور بائیں آنکھ کے قریب کاٹ لیا تھا۔ بچے کو کتے کے کاٹنے کے بعد ابتدائی طور پر ریبیز ویکسین کی دو خوراکیں تو لگائی گئی تھیں، تاہم اسے ریبیز امیونوگلوبیولن فراہم نہیں کیا گیا تھا۔ بچے کو جب اسپتال لایا گیا تو اس میں تیز بخار، پانی سے خوف اور شدید بے چینی کی علامات پائی گئیں، جہاں ڈاکٹروں نے طبی جانچ کے بعد اس میں ریبیز انسیفلائٹس کی تشخیص کی۔ علاج کے باوجود بچہ جانبر نہ ہو سکا اور انتقال کر گیا۔ طبی اعداد و شمار کے مطابق جناح اسپتال میں ہی رواں برس ریبیز کے باعث گیارہ اموات واقع ہو چکی ہیں۔ اس کے علاوہ انڈس اسپتال کراچی میں اس موذی مرض سے انتیس افراد جبکہ انڈس اسپتال بدین میں ایک شخص جان کی بازی ہار چکا ہے۔ اس صورتحال میں ماہرینِ صحت اور متعلقہ اداروں کی طرف سے کتے کے کاٹنے کے بعد بروقت اور مکمل طبی امداد، بشمول تمام ضروری ویکسین اور امیونوگلوبیولن کے بروقت استعمال کی اہمیت پر زور دیا جا رہا ہے تاکہ اس قسم کے قیمتی انسانی جانوں کے ضیاع کو روکا جا سکے۔

stories.title: James Talarico Ends Democratic Losing Streak with Historic Texas Senate Victory
stories.summary:
State Representative James Talarico won the United States Senate race in Texas on Tuesday according to media projections, defeating the Donald Trump-backed Republican candidate, Ken Paxton. This outcome terminates a 32-year statewide losing streak for Democrats in a traditionally Republican-dominated state where Trump previously won by 14 percentage points in 2024. Talarico's win provides a vital boost for his party in the broader national battle for control of the United States Senate.

Paxton, who serves as the Texas attorney general, faced multiple controversies prior to the election, including a securities fraud case and a 2023 impeachment. Throughout the primary cycle, Paxton secured Trump's endorsement, which led to the primary defeat of incumbent Republican Senator John Cornyn, whom party leaders had previously considered a stronger general election contender. Paxton utilized his position as attorney general to file more than 100 lawsuits against the administration of former President Joe Biden. As attorney general, Paxton's legal maneuvers were a prominent feature of his political profile.

Talarico emerged victorious in the most expensive Senate contest of the current cycle, overcoming heavy outside spending and a total Republican expenditure of more than $316 million aimed at retaining the seat. Initially considered an underdog against former US Representative Colin Allred—who withdrew to run again for the House—Talarico advanced to secure the Democratic nomination by defeating US Representative Jasmine Crockett. Entering Tuesday's vote, Republicans held a 47-53 majority in the Senate, with Democrats requiring a net gain of four seats to secure majority control.

stories.title: Mughal Energy Plans 25MW Solar Plant to Power Generation Facility
stories.summary:
Mughal Energy Limited has received board approval to install a 25-megawatt solar power plant designed to offset auxiliary power usage at its existing power generation facility. The decision was finalized by the company's board of directors during a meeting on Wednesday, according to an official filing submitted to the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Mughal Energy Limited operates as a subsidiary of Mughal Iron & Steel Industries Limited.

The capital for the proposed solar installation will be secured through a mix of debt and equity, which will include financial contributions from sponsors and directors. The enterprise noted that the exact financing structure, including the specific debt-to-equity ratio, will be established based on project requirements, commercial feasibility, and final financing arrangements. The organization did not make public any estimated project costs or projected completion timeframes in its disclosure.

This new initiative follows earlier developments in August, when Mughal Energy Limited successfully commissioned the main 31.50 MW turbine for its captive hybrid power plant project. Mughal Iron & Steel Industries Limited was originally incorporated in Pakistan on February 16, 2010. While the broader parent company participates in both ferrous and non-ferrous business sectors, its primary operational focus remains the manufacturing and sale of mild steel products within the ferrous category.

stories.title: Government and Jamaat-e-Islami Nearing Agreement on Petroleum Levy Relief
stories.summary:
Representatives from the federal government and Jamaat-e-Islami (JI) are scheduled to meet in Islamabad to finalize a draft agreement regarding the potential elimination of the petroleum levy. The discussions center on a government proposal for a phased withdrawal of the levy alongside targeted relief measures for specific groups.

The government delegation features Federal Minister Ahsan Iqbal, Rana Sanaullah, and other relevant officials, while the Jamaat-e-Islami team includes Nasrullah Randhawa and Syed Farasat Shah. Following these committee-level talks, the leadership of both factions will review and approve the final text of the agreement.

Under the terms discussed so far, the administration has agreed in principle to gradually phase out the petroleum levy. Officials have also expressed willingness to extend financial relief to the agricultural sector and owners of vehicles with engine capacities up to 800cc and 1,000cc.

This development follows an earlier decision by the federal government to amend the Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy and Climate Support Levy) Ordinance of 1961. The initiative comes in response to escalating criticisms regarding high fuel prices and the petroleum levy, which have severely strained the financial stability of low-income households. Jamaat-e-Islami has consistently campaigned for the total removal of the levy to ease the burden on consumers struggling with steep fuel expenses.

stories.title: UN Court to Deliver Myanmar Rohingya Genocide Ruling on November 19
stories.summary:
The International Court of Justice will deliver a landmark ruling on November 19 regarding whether Myanmar's military crackdown against its Rohingya minority constituted genocide. Judges at the top United Nations court have spent seven years evaluating accusations brought by The Gambia, which argued that Myanmar breached the 1948 UN Genocide Convention during the violent repression.

The case stems from a brutal 2017 military crackdown in Rakhine State that forced hundreds of thousands of Rohingya to flee to Bangladesh, creating the world's largest refugee settlement. While the ICJ lacks enforcement mechanisms, a ruling against Myanmar would increase international pressure on leader Min Aung Hlaing, who commanded the military during the operation and currently faces related legal challenges, including an International Criminal Court arrest warrant request.

Myanmar has consistently denied the allegations, maintaining that its security forces targeted a military uprising following insurgent attacks. During court hearings, Gambian Justice Minister Dawda Jallow stated that the Rohingya suffered horrific violence, while Myanmar officials dismissed the claims as unsubstantiated. Former civilian leader Aung Suu Kyi previously addressed the court in 2019 to deny any genocidal intent, though she will not attend the upcoming verdict due to house arrest following the 2021 military coup.

Legal experts are closely watching the decision for potential parallels to a separate genocide case brought by South Africa against Israel over its Gaza campaign. In 2020, the ICJ ordered Myanmar to take all possible measures to prevent genocidal acts and confirmed it has the jurisdiction to judge the case.

stories.title: Novak Djokovic Overcomes Valentin Vacherot in Paris Masters First Round
stories.summary:
Novak Djokovic fought back from a set down to defeat Valentin Vacherot 6-7 (5/7), 7-5, 6-1 in the opening round of the Paris Masters on Tuesday. The victory marked the 24-time Grand Slam champion's first win at an ATP 1000-level tournament since reaching the fourth round at Indian Wells in March, while also exacting revenge for his loss to the Monegasque player at the Shanghai Masters last season.

After dropping a tight first-set tie-break, Djokovic called for a medical timeout to treat his right shoulder early in the second set. The brief stoppage disrupted Vacherot, who struggled with a foot issue and eventually conceded the second set as Djokovic broke in the 12th game. The Serbian star then dominated the deciding set to secure his advancement to the second round, where he will face Rinky Hijikata.

The win keeps alive Djokovic's slim hopes of qualifying for the season-ending ATP Finals in Turin, as he currently sits 11th in the race for the eight-man tournament. However, the seven-time Paris champion stated his primary focus is simply winning every match in his return to the event.

Elsewhere at the Paris Masters, third seed Ben Shelton defeated Cameron Norrie in straight sets, and Casper Ruud advanced past Rafael Jodar. The tournament also featured a retirement tribute for French player Gael Monfils, alongside early exits for Holger Rune and Moise Kouame, ahead of matches featuring top seed Alexander Zverev and Carlos Alcaraz.

stories.title: Raphinha and Lamine Yamal Lead Barcelona Past Aston Villa
stories.summary:
Barcelona secured a 3-0 victory over Aston Villa in the Champions League on Tuesday, ending the English side's perfect start to the competition. Lamine Yamal opened the scoring early in the first half following a defensive error, before Raphinha added two goals after the halftime break to seal the win and keep Barcelona in contention for a top-eight league phase finish.

The match began without the traditional Champions League anthem as a mark of respect for Tenerife striker Jesus De Miguel, who passed away earlier that day following an on-pitch collision in a Spanish second division match. Players and managers expressed their condolences to De Miguel's family before kickoff in heavy rain at the Camp Nou.

Yamal capitalized on a misplaced pass from Joao Gomes inside the penalty box in the seventh minute to score his 14th career Champions League goal, surpassing Kylian Mbappe's previous record for goals scored as a teenager in the tournament. Despite Aston Villa creating some opportunities through Matty Cash and Anthony Gordon, Barcelona's high press and solid defense kept the visitors at bay.

In the second half, Fermin Lopez set up Raphinha for a close-range finish, and Joao Cancelo provided a cross for Raphinha's second goal of the night, bringing his season tally to 19 goals across all competitions. The clean sheet was Barcelona's first in 19 Champions League matches, leaving manager Hansi Flick pleased with his back line's disciplined performance.

stories.title: Manchester United Stage Stunning Comeback While PSG Dominate Champions League
stories.summary:
Manchester United secured a thrilling 3-2 victory against Roma in the Champions League on Tuesday, easing the pressure on manager Michael Carrick after falling two goals behind within 18 minutes. First-half goals from Mathias Soule and a penalty by Donyell Malen initially sparked furious protests from United fans at Old Trafford, who hurled objects and chanted against majority owners, the Glazer family. However, a transformed United performance after the interval changed the mood entirely. Captain Bruno Fernandes converted a 58th-minute penalty after Roma's third-choice goalkeeper Devis Vasquez saw his initial save nullified due to teammate encroachment. Matheus Cunha then scored twice in three minutes near the end of the match to complete the comeback, though Cunha was subsequently sent off in stoppage time. The defeat marked another blown lead for Roma following a similar collapse against Real Madrid.

In other European fixtures, holders Paris Saint-Germain maintained their perfect record by thrashing Villarreal 6-0 despite resting several key players, including Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, Ousmane Dembele, captain Marquinhos, and Nuno Mendes. PSG set a tournament record for the fastest four goals scored in a match by netting four times in an eight-minute first-half span through Joao Neves, Desire Doue, Senny Mayulu, and Fabian Ruiz. Further goals from Ruiz and teenager David Boly sealed the victory, placing Luis Enrique's side at the top of the table. Prior to kickoff, matches across Europe observed a moment of silence for Tenerife player Jesus de Miguel, who died at age 30 from injuries sustained in a collision during a Spanish second-division game.

Meanwhile, a depleted Bayern Munich defeated Atletico Madrid 2-0 in Spain through second-half goals from teenage forward Lennart Karl and Konrad Laimer, moving Bayern into the top eight despite missing Jamal Musiala, Luis Diaz, Serge Gnabry, and Ismael Saibari. Inter Milan rebounded from a weekend derby loss by defeating Feyenoord 3-0 with goals from Yann Bisseck, Pio Esposito, and Piotr Zielinski. United now look ahead to a weekend match against Aston Villa, who suffered a 3-0 defeat to Barcelona.

stories.title: وزیراعظم کا پیٹرول پر ریلیف نہ دینے والے پمپس کے خلاف سخت کارروائی کا حکم
stories.summary:
وفاقی کابینہ کے اجلاس سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے ہدایت کی ہے کہ پیٹرول کی قیمتوں میں کمی کا ریلیف عوام تک نہ پہنچانے والے پیٹرول پمپس کے خلاف سخت کارروائی عمل میں لائی جائے۔ انہوں نے وزیرِ پیٹرولیم کو حکم دیا کہ ایسے پمپس کے خلاف فوری ایکشن لیا جائے۔

وزیراعظم نے بتایا کہ جمعے کے روز پیٹرول کی قیمت میں پندره روپے فی لیٹر اضافے کا خدشہ تھا، تاہم بروقت فیصلوں اور ریفائنریز سے ونڈ فال منافع شیئر کروانے کی وجہ سے یہ اضافہ روک لیا گیا۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ ایل پی جی مافیا کا دور اب ختم ہو چکا ہے اور ایل پی جی کی درآمد سے عوام کو مزید ریلیف فراہم کیا جائے گا۔

معاشی اور ترقیاتی امور پر بات کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے کہا کہ چھوٹے و درمیانے درجے کے کاروبار، ہاؤسنگ اور زراعت کا شعبہ ملکی ترقی کے لیے انتہائی اہم ہیں۔ اس کے علاوہ انہوں نے بتایا کہ اب تک ساڑھے سات کروڑ افراد فیول ٹوکن سے فائدہ اٹھا چکے ہیں جس پر اٹھائیس ارب روپے خرچ کیے گئے ہیں۔

خیبر پختون خوا کے حوالے سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیراعظم نے کہا کہ صوبے کے لیے ایک سو ساٹھ ارب روپے کے پیکیج کو حتمی شکل دے دی گئی ہے جہاں امن و امان اولین ترجیح ہے۔ انہوں نے اس عزم کا اظہار کیا کہ دہشت گردی کا مکمل خاتمہ کیا جائے گا جبکہ عالمی سطح پر تیل کی بڑھتی قیمتوں کے باوجود پاکستان خطے میں امن کے لیے سفارتی کوششیں جاری رکھے ہوئے ہے۔

stories.title: شناختی کارڈ نمبر غلط ملزم سے منسوب، سندھ ہائیکورٹ نے ریکارڈ طلب کر لیا
stories.summary:
سندھ ہائیکورٹ میں کراچی کے ایک شہری کا شناختی کارڈ نمبر ہم نام ملزم سے غلط طور پر منسوب کیے جانے کے معاملے پر سماعت ہوئی۔ عدالت کو بتایا گیا کہ پاک کالونی پولیس کی جانب سے غلط اندراج کی وجہ سے درخواست گزار کے شناختی کارڈ پر انیس مقدمات کا ریکارڈ ڈال دیا گیا۔

درخواست گزار کے وکیل نے عدالت کو آگاہ کیا کہ اس غلطی کے نتیجے میں شہری کے ناقابلِ ضمانت وارنٹ جاری ہوئے اور اس کا شناختی کارڈ بھی بلاک کر دیا گیا۔ غلط ریکارڈ کی بنیاد پر شہری کو ایک ہفتے تک پولیس کی حراست میں بھی رہنا پڑا جبکہ بارہا درخواستوں کے باوجود ریکارڈ درست نہیں کیا گیا۔

چیف جسٹس سندھ ہائیکورٹ ظفر احمد راجپوت کی ہدایت پر اس حوالے سے سرکلر بھی جاری کیا جا چکا ہے۔ عدالت نے اس سنگین معاملے کا نوٹس لیتے ہوئے متعلقہ حکام سے شہری کے نام پر درج تمام مقدمات کا مکمل ریکارڈ طلب کر لیا ہے۔

عدالت نے اس کیس کی مزید سماعت پندرہ دسمبر تک کے لیے ملتوی کر دی ہے۔ اس غلط اندراج کے باعث بے گناہ شہری کو جن قانونی مشکلات اور ناکردہ جرائم کا سامنا کرنا پڑا، عدالت اس کی چھان بین کر رہی ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistan Gold Prices Surge Following International Market Gains
stories.summary:
Gold prices in Pakistan experienced a significant increase on Wednesday, driven by rising rates in the international market. Local market figures from the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association (APGJSA) showed the price of gold per tola climbed by Rs13,900 to reach Rs426,036.

Similarly, the price for 10 grams of gold rose by Rs11,917, settling at Rs365,257. These domestic hikes followed a stable trading session on Tuesday when the per tola gold price remained unchanged at Rs412,136.

On the global stage, international gold rates increased by $139, pushing the price to $4,035 per ounce. Precious metals saw broad upward movement as silver prices in the local market also climbed, increasing by Rs295 to reach Rs5,663 per tola.

stories.title: SSGC Releases Winter Gas Supply Schedule for Sindh and Balochistan
stories.summary:
The Sui Southern Gas Company (SSGC) released its winter gas supply schedule on Wednesday for domestic consumers across Sindh and Balochistan, following directives from the federal government. According to an SSGC spokesperson, the new schedule takes effect immediately and outlines three specific daily supply slots aimed at prioritizing households during traditional meal times.

The announcement comes after consumers in Karachi faced a severe gas crisis over the preceding days. Public confusion had escalated earlier in the week when multiple contradictory supply schedules attributed to the utility circulated on social media starting Monday, while the company had refrained from issuing a clear, consolidated statement until late Tuesday evening.

The implemented measures attempt to address long-standing supply challenges. For several years, SSGC customers have not experienced round-the-clock gas availability, making structured distribution schedules critical for managing household needs during the winter season across the two provinces.

stories.title: Democrats Win US Congress in Midterm Sweep Rejecting Donald Trump
stories.summary:
Democrats captured control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives in a nationwide midterm wave on November 3, 2026, dealing a severe blow to President Donald Trump. The opposition victory empowers Democrats to block legislation, launch expansive investigations into the administration, and halt judicial and senior appointments. Voters expressed deep dissatisfaction over living costs, tariffs, and the war against Iran, which pushed fuel prices higher. Despite past disputes over election integrity, Trump told The New York Times he would accept the results and work with Democrats, though he simultaneously posted an image of a red hat emblazoned with the word "VETO" on social media.

The Democratic Senate gains featured historic upsets in traditionally conservative states. In Kansas, Methodist minister Adam Hamilton defeated Republican incumbent Roger Marshall, marking the first Democratic Senate win in the state since 1932. Iowa elected its first Democratic senator since 2008. In Texas, Democrat James Talarico defeated Trump-backed candidate and state attorney general Ken Paxton, overcoming heavy backing from tech billionaire Elon Musk, while Gina Hinojosa unseated Republican Governor Greg Abbott. Additional Democratic victories included J.D. Ford flipping a seat in Indiana, Jon Ossoff retaining his seat in Georgia, and former Atlanta mayor Keisha Lance Bottoms becoming the first Black woman elected governor in US history.

In California, former federal cabinet secretary Xavier Becerra easily defeated Republican Steve Hilton to become the state's first elected Latino governor, succeeding term-limited Governor Gavin Newsom. Becerra secured nearly a two-to-one advantage over Hilton, a former adviser to British Prime Minister David Cameron, who conceded the difficult race for Republicans. Republicans found isolated bright spots in Florida, where Byron Donalds won the governorship as the state's first Black governor and Ashley Moody retained a Senate seat.

Political analysts characterized the results as a strong repudiation of Trump and his policies. Armed with new majorities, congressional Democrats are positioned to challenge the administration on corruption, immigration, and foreign policy. House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries declared the MAGA movement to be on the run, while expected House Oversight Committee leader Robert Garcia warned Republicans to "LAWYER UP".

stories.title: Karachi Municipal Town Chairmen Challenge Pensioner Fund Mandate in Court
stories.summary:
Several municipal town chairmen in Karachi have formally approached the Sindh High Court to contest government directives requiring the earmarking of funds for retired employees. According to the legal representatives representing the petitioners, the local government administration instructed municipal towns to reserve twenty percent of their financial resources for pensioners.

During the proceedings, the petitioners' counsel argued that no existing legal framework or statutory reference mandates such a financial set-aside. The lawyers cautioned that dedicating a fifth of the municipal budget exclusively to pensions would severely impede ongoing and future urban development initiatives across the city's various towns.

In response to the constitutional petition, the Sindh High Court has formally issued notices to key figures including the Secretary of the Local Government and the Director General of the Local Government department. The judiciary has ordered the respondents to submit their formal replies to the court by December 18.

The case highlights ongoing financial and administrative disputes between local municipal leadership and provincial departments regarding budget management. The outcome of the high court proceedings could significantly impact how local government funds are distributed and utilized for municipal development projects throughout Karachi.

stories.title: Pakistan Stock Exchange and State Bank to Close for Iqbal Day
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited and the State Bank of Pakistan will remain closed on Monday, November 9, 2026. The closure is observed in commemoration of Allama Iqbal Day, which is officially designated as a national holiday by the Government of Pakistan.

In an official notice issued to all TRE certificate holders, staff, and relevant stakeholders, the stock exchange confirmed the scheduled break. The announcement aligns with prior declarations made by the central bank regarding the nationwide observance of the public holiday.

All operations and trading activities at the Pakistan Stock Exchange will pause for the day and resume following the conclusion of the national holiday. Similarly, banking operations overseen by the State Bank of Pakistan will be suspended during this period.

The annual observance honors the birth anniversary of Allama Iqbal, a prominent poet and philosopher whose contributions are celebrated nationwide. Consequently, financial institutions across the country observe a day of rest in accordance with the official government holiday schedule.

stories.title: Federal Constitutional Court Issues New Legal Principles for State Recruitment
stories.summary:
The Federal Constitutional Court has established six core legal principles regulating government recruitment processes through a written judgment delivered by Chief Justice Aminuddin Khan. The ruling addresses disqualifications based on criminal records, determining that withholding public sector employment from a candidate simply due to an acquittal breaches Articles 4 and 25 of the Constitution. Furthermore, the court declared that the mere filing of a First Information Report cannot legally disqualify an applicant.

The judicial panel emphasized that once a candidate is cleared of charges, their character must be evaluated using reliable evidence rather than past police actions or suspicion. The ruling forbids negative remarks related to acquitted cases on police character certificates and restricts mentions of pending cases to their exact legal status. Additionally, the court mandated that no individual may be excluded from hiring consideration without being granted an adequate right to a hearing.

As part of the judgment, the court overturned a previous ruling issued on May 22, 2025, by the Lahore High Court’s Multan Bench regarding applicant Abdul Latif. Latif had attained second place on the merit list but faced disqualification over a 2018 criminal case despite receiving a clean police certificate from Dera Ghazi Khan. The Federal Constitutional Court denounced the administrative rejection as an abuse of authority and an act of legal mala fide grounded in suspicion rather than established facts.

Consequently, the court voided the disqualification notification, reinstated Latif’s merit position, and ordered authorities to finish his medical examination and necessary formalities within thirty days to facilitate his appointment.

stories.title: Israeli Election Commission Dismisses Netanyahu Fraud Claims as Leaders Await Results
stories.summary:
Israeli electoral authorities have dismissed fraud allegations raised by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu concerning Arab-majority parties following the October 27 election. The Central Elections Committee stated that an audit of 9,069 polling stations confirmed the final results faithfully represent the electorate's choices, noting zero evidence of compromised electoral integrity. President Isaac Herzog is set to receive the official results to determine whether to task Netanyahu or rival Gadi Eisenkot with forming a government.

Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving leader who faces ongoing corruption trials, had accused Arab factions of voter manipulation involving cash envelopes and foreign funding. Concurrently, Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara stated she would not interrogate individuals without concrete proof, drawing sharp criticism from Netanyahu's Likud party. Eisenkot and opposition figures strongly condemned Likud's rhetoric, arguing it undermines democratic institutions as political factions manoeuvre to end Netanyahu's tenure.

Neither Netanyahu nor Eisenkot holds the 61-seat majority required in the 120-member parliament, with Netanyahu's bloc holding 53 seats and Eisenkot's holding 48. Eisenkot could potentially reach the majority threshold by partnering with Arab-minority parties, whose representation grew to 19 seats, though some opposition members hesitate to rely on non-Jewish legislators. President Herzog will initiate consultations with political parties immediately after receiving the certified results to explore stability options, including a possible unity government.

Once designated, the appointed candidate will have 28 days, with a potential 14-day extension, to assemble a governing coalition. Failure by both designated leaders to form a government could lead to lawmakers attempting to nominate a consensus candidate or forcing the nation into new elections. The outcome remains critical for Netanyahu, whose political survival currently preserves his legal immunity.

stories.title: Hakeem Jeffries Set to Become First Black US House Speaker
stories.summary:
Following a Democratic midterm election victory, Representative Hakeem Jeffries is positioned to become the first Black speaker of the US House of Representatives. Jeffries, representing a New York City district, will take leadership of a majority-controlled House in the first week of January, succeeding Republicans who held power for four years. In a victory speech late Tuesday, Jeffries criticized the Trump-led Republican agenda and vowed to reverse recent spending cuts to the Medicaid healthcare program enacted on July 4, 2025.

Jeffries aims to address the high cost of living for working and middle-class Americans while also probing the Trump administration's corporate dealings, though he has not committed to pursuing a third impeachment of President Donald Trump. While Democratic aides indicate no serious opposition to his upcoming internal nomination, Jeffries must balance the expectations of progressives pushing for policies like universal healthcare and voting rights against moderate Democrats wary of political overreach.

At 56 years old, Jeffries is recognized as a consensus builder within his caucus. Alongside tackling the affordability crisis, his legislative priorities include renewing child and housing tax credits, restoring clean energy subsidies, and reinstating Obamacare benefits. He will also need to engage in bipartisan cooperation with Republicans to raise the federal debt limit and avert government shutdowns.

Managing a diverse legislative caucus will present distinct hurdles as newly elected progressives enter Washington with high expectations despite the White House remaining under Republican control. Analysts emphasize that avoiding intense impeachment battles and focusing on economic relief will be vital for unifying his party as the new Congress convenes.

stories.title: Abdul El-Sayed Wins Michigan Race to Become First Muslim US Senator
stories.summary:
Democrat Abdul El-Sayed secured victory in Michigan's US Senate race against former Republican lawmaker Mike Rogers, making him the first Muslim elected to the upper chamber of Congress. El-Sayed triumphed despite a late endorsement of his opponent by fellow Democrat Haley Stevens, ultimately holding a nearly six-point lead when media networks called the election early Wednesday.

During his campaign, the 42-year-old medical administrator focused heavily on economic populist platforms, including universal healthcare and removing money from politics, to replace the retiring Senator Gary Peters. His victory also marks a historic milestone as the first time a Democratic doctor has entered the Senate since 1969. El-Sayed drew substantial crowds and built broad coalitions, receiving significant logistical backing from union activists and organized labor.

Republicans targeted El-Sayed with aggressive campaigning, while he also faced Islamophobic attacks and ridicule regarding his Arabic name from President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance. Nevertheless, his grassroots campaign resonated across both urban centers and conservative areas throughout the state of Michigan.

Addressing supporters at his Detroit election night headquarters, El-Sayed celebrated the historic milestone alongside diverse groups of voters, influencers, and community leaders. He pointedly reminded Vice President JD Vance of his constitutional duty to administer his swearing-in ceremony in January.

stories.title: Gina Hinojosa Defeats Greg Abbott in Historic Texas Governor Upset
stories.summary:
Democratic state Representative Gina Hinojosa defeated three-term Republican Governor Greg Abbott in a major political upset, ending the Republican Party's three-decade hold on the Texas governor's office. This victory makes Hinojosa the first Hispanic individual elected to lead the state, breaking a statewide electoral drought for Democrats that has persisted since 1994.

Hinojosa's campaign strategy focused on convincing Latino voters that pressing economic challenges and underfunded public schools outweighed cultural wedge issues. Her victory coincided with state Representative James Talarico defeating Trump-backed Republican candidate Ken Paxton in the Texas US Senate race, marking a dramatic shift in a traditionally solid conservative stronghold.

Voto Latino Executive Director Beatriz Lopez noted that the sweeping Democratic gains were propelled by high Latino voter turnout driven by economic anxiety and opposition to aggressive immigration policies. Voto Latino registered approximately 400,000 voters in Texas during the current election cycle alone.

Political analysts view these statewide victories as part of a broader nationwide Democratic wave. The results effectively transform Texas into a competitive battleground state ahead of the upcoming 2028 presidential election cycle.

stories.title: Democrats Win Control of US Congress in Midterm Elections
stories.summary:
Democratic candidates secured full control of the United States Congress following a sweeping midterm election outcome on Tuesday. The legislative victories handed both the House of Representatives and the Senate to the Democrats, empowering them to block President Donald Trump's agenda and launch investigations during the final two years of his presidential term.

The election results underscored voter frustrations regarding living costs, tariffs, and military involvement concerning Iran. Despite these outcomes, 80-year-old President Donald Trump expressed willingness to work alongside the Democrats, though he simultaneously posted an image of a baseball cap bearing the word "VETO" to signal his legislative stance.

Key senatorial upsets drove the Democratic wave into traditional Republican strongholds. In Kansas, Adam Hamilton defeated Roger Marshall to become the first Democrat elected to the Senate from the state since 1932. Additional breakthroughs occurred in Iowa, Texas, South Carolina, North Carolina, and Ohio, where James Talarico defeated a Republican candidate backed by Trump and Elon Musk. Meanwhile, Gina Hinojosa won the Texas governorship to end decades of Republican control over the office.

In California, Xavier Becerra easily defeated Steve Hilton to become the state's first elected Latino governor, succeeding term-limited Governor Gavin Newsom. Additionally, Keisha Lance Bottoms won the Georgia governorship to become the first Black woman elected governor in United States history. Analysts noted that the Democratic gains represent a severe rebuke of Donald Trump and his policies, equipping the party to oversee judicial appointments, senior nominations, and administrative investigations.

stories.title: ساہیوال: بیرونِ ملک ملازمت کا جھانسہ دے کر رقم بٹورنے والے 3 ملزمان گرفتار
stories.summary:
ایف آئی اے فیصل آباد کے ہیومن ٹریفکنگ سرکل نے ساہیوال میں ایک کارروائی کے دوران 3 ملزمان کو گرفتار کر لیا ہے۔ ان ملزمان پر الزام ہے کہ انہوں نے ایک شہری کو بیرونِ ملک ملازمت دلوانے کا جھانسہ دے کر 10 لاکھ روپے وصول کیے تھے۔

پولیس کے مطابق ملزمان نے متاثرہ شہری سے رقم تو لے لی لیکن نہ تو اسے بیرونِ ملک ملازمت دلائی اور نہ ہی اس کی رقم واپس کی۔ ایف آئی اے نے کارروائی کے دوران ملزمان کی نشاندہی پر واردات میں استعمال ہونے والا سامان بھی برآمد کر لیا ہے۔

ترجمان ایف آئی اے کا کہنا ہے کہ گرفتار کیے جانے والے تینوں ملزمان کے خلاف باضابطہ مقدمہ درج کر لیا گیا ہے۔ مقدمہ درج کرنے کے بعد قانون کے مطابق مزید تفتیش کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے۔

اس کارروائی کے ذریعے انسانی اسمگلنگ اور شہریوں کو دھوکہ دینے والے عناصر کے خلاف گھیرا تنگ کیا جا رہا ہے۔ متعلقہ اداروں کی جانب سے اس نوعیت کے جرائم میں ملوث افراد کے خلاف کارروائیاں مسلسل جاری رکھی جا رہی ہیں۔

stories.title: ضلع خیبر کے علاقے جمرود سے انسدادِ پولیو ٹیم کا سپروائزر اغواء
stories.summary:
ضلع خیبر میں جمرود کے علاقے چپری سے پولیو ٹیم کے سپروائزر کو نامعلوم مسلح افراد کی جانب سے اغواء کر لیا گیا ہے۔ یہ واقعہ اس وقت پیش آیا جب علاقے میں انسدادِ پولیو مہم جاری تھی۔

ڈی پی او وقار احمد کے مطابق واقعے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی پولیس کی بھاری نفری فوری طور پر جائے وقوعہ پر پہنچ گئی۔ پولیس نے علاقے کے اہم راستوں کی ناکہ بندی کر دی ہے تاکہ ملزمان کا فرار ناممکن بنایا جا سکے۔

ڈی پی او نے بتایا کہ مغوی سپروائزر کی بحفاظت بازیابی اور اس گھناؤنے فعل میں ملوث مسلح افراد کی گرفتاری کے لیے تمام ممکنہ کوششیں جاری ہیں۔ پولیس کی ٹیمیں علاقے میں سرگرم ہیں۔

خیال رہے کہ ضلع بھر میں گزشتہ روز سے 7 روزہ خصوصی انسدادِ پولیو مہم کا آغاز کیا گیا تھا جس کے دوران یہ افسوسناک واقعہ رونما ہوا۔ حکام اس معاملے پر سختی سے نظر رکھے ہوئے ہیں۔

stories.title: European Markets Decline Following US Democratic Congressional Sweep
stories.summary:
European stock markets are anticipated to open lower as technology shares draw intense scrutiny following the Democratic Party's capture of both chambers of the United States Congress. Futures tracking the STOXX 600 dropped approximately 0.2 percent by 0639 GMT, trimming losses after a 1.4 percent decline seen during Asian trading hours. Concurrently, contracts following the German DAX fell about 0.2 percent, while the United Kingdom's FTSE 100 futures dropped 0.4 percent.

The shift in American legislative power generated investor anxiety regarding potential tighter regulatory oversight on artificial intelligence technologies. Market participants worry that stricter rules concerning data center construction could cause artificial intelligence companies to exercise greater caution regarding capital expenditures, potentially dampening a sector that has heavily propelled recent market gains.

Although technology firms represent roughly 7 percent of the STOXX index, the sector has delivered the third-strongest performance this year due to robust demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure. Consequently, equipment manufacturers including Siemens Energy and Schneider Electric will face heightened investor focus during the trading sessions.

In other market news, healthcare stocks will remain closely watched as investors evaluate potential regulatory changes regarding drug pricing in the United States. Attention will also center on pharmaceutical firm Novo Nordisk after the Wegovy manufacturer posted third-adjusted operating profits exceeding expectations alongside an upward revision of its full-year sales and profit projections.

stories.title: WNBA Player Sophie Cunningham Hires 24/7 Security Amid Safety Concerns
stories.summary:
As the popularity of the Women's National Basketball Association experiences rapid growth, player safety has emerged as a major topic of discussion across the league. Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham announced that she has hired a round-the-clock personal security team to accompany her continuously during her travels, citing a series of disturbing public interactions and mounting concerns over personal privacy and stalking.

Speaking on her podcast No Hesitation, which she co-hosts with Drew Hanlen, Cunningham explained how her expanding public profile has altered her everyday routines. She noted that while she appreciates the league and its fans, the loss of personal anonymity creates significant safety challenges that now require permanent protection regardless of the city or state she visits.

Cunningham's announcement follows previous remarks on Theo Von's podcast titled This Past Weekend, where she highlighted the hidden drawbacks of professional sports fame and noted that safety threats faced by players are frequently overlooked publicly. Court documents and news reports have increasingly underscored targeted harassment issues within the league, citing prior felony stalking, intimidation, and harassment charges against individuals who directed unwanted phone calls, messages, and packages toward venues like Gainbridge Fieldhouse.

Other prominent WNBA figures, including captain Caitlin Clark, have similarly been targets of stalking incidents that resulted in official arrests and jail terms. Despite these escalating security challenges, Cunningham acknowledged proactive efforts undertaken by both the WNBA and the Indiana Fever franchise to enhance player protection as venue sellouts and media coverage reach unprecedented levels.

stories.title: Nepali Workers Stranded in Saudi Arabia Due to Flight Disruptions
stories.summary:
Hundreds of Nepali workers in Saudi Arabia have been left stranded following flight cancellations caused by security incidents, including a Houthi rebel attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that resulted in 13 deaths and over 300 injuries. Between October 8 and 25, roughly 45 percent of scheduled flights across Saudi airports were cancelled, with Riyadh's cancellations reaching 86 percent. Major routes, such as direct flights between Kathmandu and Dammam, have also been halted, forcing airlines like Nepal Airlines and Himalaya Airlines to suspend multiple services.

Workers attempting to return home for the Dashain and Tihar festivals face severe logistical and financial challenges. Many have had to endure long, costly journeys by bus to alternative airports or cities, only to encounter repeated cancellations, unclear refund policies, and soaring ticket prices that have reached up to Rs 100,000 for a one-way fare. Others, such as those with expiring exit permits or workers located near regional hubs like Najran, worry about legal status and missing upcoming holidays entirely.

Approximately 400,000 Nepalis reside and work in Saudi Arabia, with the Department of Foreign Employment noting that about 7,000 individuals receive or renew labor permits monthly. The Nepali Embassy in Riyadh, along with local labor representatives and community associations, has been assisting stranded nationals by urging employers to provide food and accommodation, and suggesting alternative travel arrangements through neighboring countries like Bahrain.

The broader security situation has further heightened anxieties among expatriate workers following previous drone attacks, such as one at the Shaybah oil field that caused casualties among foreign workers. While the Saudi aviation sector is slowly working to resume operations and individual airlines offer ticket changes or refunds, the uncertainty continues to place immense mental and financial stress on stranded laborers waiting to rejoin their families.

stories.title: WNBA Finals Game 7 Sets Viewership Record With 3.3 Million Viewers
stories.summary:
The decisive seventh game of the 2026 WNBA Finals achieved historic viewership, drawing an average audience of 3.3 million viewers across USA Network, CNBC, and Peacock. This figure surpassed the league's previous playoff record set in 1999, when 3.25 million fans tuned into Game 3 between the New York Liberty and Houston Comets. The broadcast also recorded a 128 percent increase compared to the most-watched game of the 2025 Finals.

On the court, the Golden State Valkyries defeated the Atlanta Dream 68-63 to capture their first WNBA championship. Finals MVP Gabby Williams led the effort with 30 points and four blocked shots during a strong second-half performance that fended off an Atlanta rally. The game capped off the league's first season utilizing an expanded best-of-seven format for the finals under a new multi-platform media partnership.

The entire seven-game series averaged 1.89 million viewers, exceeding the previous series record of 1.5 million established during the 2024 Finals. Alongside record television ratings, the league has seen continued growth in attendance and merchandise sales over the past five consecutive years.

As the league's popularity surges, player safety has become a prominent discussion topic. In response to recent disturbing interactions, Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham announced that she has hired a 24-hour personal security team to travel with her.

stories.title: Holders Spain Drawn in Group A1 for 2027 Women's Nations League
stories.summary:
Reigning champions Spain have been placed in Group A1 for the 2027 UEFA Women's Nations League alongside Norway, Ireland, and Switzerland. The tournament draw took place on Tuesday, setting the stage for the third edition of the biennial competition for UEFA’s senior women's national teams, which is scheduled to begin in February 2027.

Spain holds the distinction of being the competition's sole winner, having secured the title in both previous editions, including a victory over Germany in the most recent final in December. Additionally, the world champions hold the 2023 Women's World Cup title after defeating England in that tournament's final.

Other notable group placements include England—winners of the 2022 and 2025 Women’s European Championships under manager Sarina Wiegman—who were drawn into Group A2 with France, Austria, and Portugal. Meanwhile, tournament runners-up Germany will compete in Group A4 alongside the Netherlands, Sweden, and Scotland.

The participating teams are divided into three leagues determined by final overall rankings from the 2026 Women’s European Qualifiers. Leagues A and B each consist of 16 teams, while League C features 22 sides, with the four League A group winners advancing to the knockout finals. The Nations League also acts as a qualification pathway for the 2028 Olympic Games in Los Angeles and UEFA Women’s Euro 2029 in Germany.

stories.title: Abdul El-Sayed Wins Michigan Senate Race to Make History
stories.summary:
Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed has won the Senate election in Michigan, defeating Republican opponent Mike Rogers. With this victory, El-Sayed is poised to become the first Muslim senator in the history of the state of Michigan.

Following his win, El-Sayed expressed gratitude to the voters of Michigan during his victory speech. He also addressed President Donald Trump, referencing past difficulties Trump had with pronouncing his name by stating, "From now on, you can simply call me Senator." El-Sayed contrasted his campaign's message of hope with what he characterized as his opponent's corporate-funded advertising strategy.

During the race, El-Sayed faced significant racist and Islamophobic rhetoric. Addressing these attacks, the Egyptian-American Muslim, who was born in Michigan, noted that opponents initially targeted his name and faith before attempting guilt by association through an aggressive campaign.

El-Sayed pushed back against these tactics, emphasizing that his identity was unrelated to everyday economic challenges faced by residents, such as the costs of gas, groceries, or healthcare.

stories.title: Lionel Scaloni Announces Argentina Squad for Friendlies Without Lionel Messi
stories.summary:
Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni revealed a 28-player squad on Tuesday for upcoming November friendlies against Uruguay and Costa Rica, marking the team's first roster since Lionel Messi's international retirement. The squad selection includes new call-ups, returning players, and established core members as Scaloni begins building the national team's future without its longtime captain.

Among the new faces is 21-year-old Chelsea defender Aaron Anselmino, who earned his maiden senior team selection. Meanwhile, Gonzalo Montiel of River Plate and Parma defender Mariano Troilo both return to the international setup. Key figures such as Alexis Mac Allister, Enzo Fernandez, and Julian Alvarez retain their places in the squad. Goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez was also named despite dealing with a fractured jaw sustained while playing for Chelsea, though his physical readiness will require evaluation before the fixtures.

The roster notably excludes Rodrigo De Paul and Giovani Lo Celso, while striker Lautaro Martinez and defender Cristian Romero are sidelined due to injuries.
