Argentina is scheduled to host Uruguay at La Bombonera on November 13 before traveling to Cordoba to play Costa Rica at the Mario Alberto Kempes stadium on November 17.

stories.title: Pakistani Opposition Alliance Meets to Evaluate Electoral Reforms Committee Invitation
stories.summary:
Lawmakers from the parliamentary opposition gathered in Islamabad on Wednesday at the residence of Maulana Fazlur Rehman to decide whether to participate in a government-proposed electoral reforms committee. Key political figures, including Leader of the Opposition Mahmood Achakzai, Barrister Gohar, and Asad Qaiser, attended the huddle to assess the broader political climate and determine the future strategy of opposition parties.

The session was called to review an official invitation extended by Federal Minister for Parliamentary Affairs Tariq Fazal Chaudhry, who had previously urged PTI’s Chief Whip Amir Dogar to submit member nominations for the parliamentary panel. However, the proposal faced resistance over its structural design. Amir Dogar publicly questioned the fairness of the committee's proposed 15-to-5 ratio favoring government members over the opposition, arguing that a more balanced representation formula is necessary for meaningful discussions.

Additionally, the opposition leaders addressed the ongoing detentions of lawmakers, focusing particularly on the custody of Sohail Afridi and the legal troubles facing roughly a dozen National Assembly members. Dogar emphasized that holding productive deliberations on electoral reforms remains challenging while numerous parliamentarians are actively facing arrest or have already been detained by authorities.

stories.title: Phil Foden Aims to Recover Best Form Ahead of Champions League Match
stories.summary:
Manchester City midfielder Phil Foden expressed growing confidence on Tuesday that he is successfully regaining the peak form that previously established him as a dominant force in the Premier League. Speaking ahead of his team's Champions League fixture against RB Leipzig, the player noted that a recent run of goal-scoring performances has helped him turn a corner following a difficult period earlier in the season.

Foden enjoyed a stellar 2024 campaign, claiming both the Premier League Player of the Season and the Professional Footballers’ Association Player of the Year awards after netting a career-high 27 goals across all competitions. That high standard slipped later on, resulting in his exclusion from England's 2026 World Cup squad. He admitted he hopes to climb back to that elite tier through consistent playing time and renewed sharpness on the pitch.

The 26-year-old midfielder's resurgence began after he served a suspension for a red card received during the Manchester derby. That enforced break allowed him to return with a fresh perspective, leading to his first Premier League goal of the season against Ipswich Town last month and a subsequent hat-trick alongside an assist in a 5-1 Champions League victory over AEK Athens. Addressing his international status, Foden confirmed he has not spoken with England manager Thomas Tuchel since missing out on the World Cup squad, choosing instead to concentrate entirely on his club performances.

stories.title: میرپور پولیس نے منگلا ڈیم سے لاش ملنے کا قتل کا معمہ حل کر لیا
stories.summary:
میرپور پولیس نے منگلا ڈیم سے وقاص الطاف نامی نوجوان کی لاش ملنے کے بعد 24 گھنٹوں کے اندر مبینہ قتل کا معمہ حل کرنے کا دعویٰ کیا ہے۔ اس کارروائی کے دوران پولیس نے دو سگے بھائیوں کو گرفتار کر لیا ہے جن کا تعلق میرپور کے نواحی علاقے سے ہے۔

ایس ایس پی میرپور خرم اقبال نے ایک پریس کانفرنس کے دوران بتایا کہ وقاص الطاف کی گمشدگی کی اطلاع ملنے کے بعد پولیس نے مقدمہ درج کر کے تحقیقات کا آغاز کیا تھا۔ نوجوان کی لاش منگلا ڈیم سے برآمد ہونے کے بعد اس واقعے کی تفتیش کو قتل کے مقدمے کے طور پر آگے بڑھایا گیا۔

پولیس ٹیم نے پیشہ ورانہ مہارت اور جدید ذرائع کو بروئے کار لاتے ہوئے اس مبینہ قتل میں ملوث دونوں سگے بھائیوں کو دبوچ لیا۔ ملزمان کی نشاندہی پر پولیس نے واردات میں استعمال ہونے والا سامان بھی اپنی تحویل میں لے لیا ہے۔

ابتدائی تفتیش کے مطابق اس قتل کی بنیادی وجہ خاندانی تنازع معلوم ہوتی ہے۔ پولیس کی جانب سے گرفتار ملزمان سے مزید پوچھ گچھ جاری ہے اور اس مقدمے کا چالان بہت جلد عدالت میں پیش کر دیا جائے گا۔

stories.title: لکی مروت میں پولیس کی کارروائی، دو مبینہ دہشتگرد ہلاک
stories.summary:
لکی مروت کے علاقے گنڈی چوک میں پولیس نے ایک کامیاب کارروائی کے دوران دو مبینہ دہشت گردوں کو ہلاک کر دیا۔ پولیس کو اس مقام پر کالے شیشوں والی ایک مشکوک گاڑی کی موجودگی کی اطلاع موصول ہوئی تھی جس پر فوری کارروائی عمل میں لائی گئی۔

جب پولیس نے مشکوک گاڑی کو روکا تو اس میں سوار دہشت گردوں نے وہاں سے فرار ہونے کی کوشش کی۔ اس دوران ہونے والی کارروائی کے نتیجے میں دو دہشت گرد مارے گئے جبکہ ان کا ایک ساتھی زخمی حالت میں فرار ہونے میں کامیاب ہو گیا۔

پولیس کے مطابق ہلاک ہونے والے مبینہ دہشت گردوں کے قبضے سے اسلحہ بھی برآمد کر لیا گیا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ پولیس نے ملزمان کی نشاندہی پر واردات میں استعمال ہونے والا دیگر سامان بھی اپنی تحویل میں لے لیا ہے۔

یہ کارروائی علاقے میں سیکیورٹی کو یقینی بنانے اور امن و امان کی صورتحال کو برقرار رکھنے کے لیے کی گئی۔ پولیس اس واقعے کے حوالے سے مزید قانونی کارروائی اور فرار ہونے والے زخمی ملزم کی تلاش میں مصروف ہے۔

stories.title: Gael Monfils Bids Emotional Farewell to Tennis Career in Paris
stories.summary:
French tennis star Gael Monfils concluded his 22-year professional career with an emotional send-off in Paris on Tuesday, expressing gratitude to the home crowd and dedicating a special message to his young daughter, Skai. Although he had initially intended to finish his career at this week’s Paris Masters, he retired quietly last month amid personal changes following the end of his marriage to fellow tennis player Elina Svitolina.

During a special on-court ceremony at the Paris tournament, Monfils was joined by fellow French tennis luminaries Jo-Wilfried Tsonga, Gilles Simon, Richard Gasquet, and Benoit Paire. Visibly moved, the 40-year-old acknowledged the difficulty of stepping away from the sport. He thanked the supporters who embraced his flamboyant, athletic style of play throughout more than two decades, describing his journey as an extraordinary story that exceeded his wildest expectations.

The most poignant moment of the farewell arrived when Monfils spoke directly to his daughter, Skai, who was born in October 2021 to Monfils and Svitolina. Reflecting on his roots in the French capital and his deep passion for the sport, he voiced his heartfelt wish that she would grow up to become a champion and one day compete in Paris herself. Recognized globally as one of the most charismatic competitors of his generation, Monfils secured 13 ATP Tour singles titles, reached Grand Slam semi-finals at the 2008 French Open and 2016 US Open, and played his final Grand Slam match at this year's US Open.

stories.title: Bayern and PSG win in Champions League as Manchester United stages comeback
stories.summary:
European football heavyweights Bayern Munich and Paris Saint-Germain reinforced their Champions League title ambitions with victories on Tuesday against Atletico Madrid and Villarreal respectively. Bayern secured a 2-0 victory in Madrid through second-half strikes from Lennart Karl and Konrad Laimer, subduing a disciplined Atletico side. Meanwhile, PSG achieved a 6-0 rout over Villarreal, setting a record as the fastest team to net four goals in a Champions League fixture. They currently lead the standings with 12 points.

At Old Trafford, Manchester United engineered a thrilling 3-2 comeback win against AS Roma after falling behind by two goals. Matias Soule opened the scoring for Roma in the 11th minute, followed by Donyell Malen's penalty seven minutes later. The early deficit triggered fan protests involving green and gold balloons and yellow tennis balls on the pitch. United captain Bruno Fernandes initiated the revival with a retaken penalty in the 58th minute, and Matheus Cunha scored twice late in the match to seal the victory before being sent off in stoppage time.

Elsewhere, Barcelona earned a comfortable 3-0 home victory against Aston Villa, sparked by an early goal from Lamine Yamal and a second-half double by Raphinha. Inter Milan delivered an equally dominant away performance, defeating Feyenoord 3-0 thanks to goals from Yann Bisseck, Pio Esposito, and Piotr Zielinski. LASK secured a 4-0 win over Slovan Bratislava, Bodo/Glimt drew 0-0 with Lille, Galatasaray beat Stuttgart 2-0 with two goals from Aleksey Batrakov, and Sporting defeated Shakhtar Donetsk 1-0 at Stamford Bridge.

Before kickoff across European stadiums, moments of silence were held to honor Tenerife player Jesus de Miguel, who passed away earlier on Tuesday. In Madrid, Bayern controlled possession against a defensive Atletico side that went into halftime without a shot on target before Karl broke the deadlock after the interval. Laimer later sealed the match from a pass provided by Harry Kane.

stories.title: Democrat Adam Hamilton wins US Senate seat in Kansas election
stories.summary:
Democrat Adam Hamilton secured victory in a US Senate race in Kansas on Tuesday, unseating Republican incumbent Roger Marshall. This milestone marks the first time a Democrat has won a Senate election in the conservative, rural state since 1932. The outcome represents a setback for President Donald Trump, who won Kansas by over 10 points in his three presidential campaigns and visited the state last week to campaign for Marshall.

Hamilton, a Methodist megachurch pastor who was registered as a Republican until recently, ran as a moderate and distanced himself from national party leaders. He pledged not to support Chuck Schumer as Senate majority leader and criticized the immigration policies of former president Joe Biden's administration. During their final debate, Hamilton emphasized his focus on his opponent rather than the president, stating he was not running against Trump.

Conversely, Marshall closely aligned his campaign with Trump's political agenda. The two candidates also disagreed on tariffs, with Hamilton advocating for ending Trump's tariffs and requiring congressional approval for new ones, while Marshall defended them. Many Kansas farmers have faced economic pressure from retaliatory export tariffs and fuel costs, while cattle ranchers opposed plans to ease beef import tariffs.

The political shift resonated in rural areas, where some voters expressed a desire for normalcy. Meanwhile, in unrelated sports news amid rising WNBA popularity, Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham announced she hired a round-the-clock personal security team following disturbing interactions.

stories.title: Pakistan's Maliha Ali defeats Russian champion at MMA world championships
stories.summary:
Maliha Ali, a 24-year-old athlete from Hunza, Gilgit-Baltistan, secured a notable victory at the IMMAF World Championships in Tbilisi, Georgia, on Tuesday. Fighting in the featherweight division, she defeated Veronika Drozdova of Russia by a split decision. Drozdova, 19, arrived at the tournament as a two-time European champion and part of a heavily funded, government-backed Russian team comprising over 60 athletes.

Maliha, who holds titles as a wushu champion and national kickboxing gold medallist, entered the event following a silver medal at the IMMAF World Cup in Angola earlier this year. Fighting from a southpaw stance, she pinned her opponent against the cage in the opening round and dominated the second round by securing a takedown and landing heavy blows from the full-mount position. Although she tired in the third round and allowed Drozdova to control the ground action, her early advantage secured the judges' decision.

Omar Ahmed, president of the Pakistan MMA Federation, praised the team's resilience, noting that Pakistan remains one of the least-resourced and most underfunded federations at the event due to national sports policies. Following Maliha's previous success in Angola, the federation held a six-week training camp and brought in an international jiu-jitsu coach to address technical weaknesses. The campaign last year was entirely self-funded through private sponsorships.

Following her victory, Maliha advanced to the quarter-finals to face Mexico's Andrea Gabriela Guzman Salazar on Wednesday. Her twin sister, Manesha, who won gold in Luanda earlier in the year, is scheduled to compete against Poland's Martyna Caruk on the same day as both athletes pursue world titles.

stories.title: Rybakina and Gauff headline Group One at upcoming WTA Finals
stories.summary:
World number one Elena Rybakina and American Coco Gauff were placed together in Group One for the upcoming WTA Finals during Tuesday's draw ceremony. Meanwhile, second-ranked Aryna Sabalenka was drawn into Group Two alongside third-ranked Mirra Andreeva. The season-ending championship features the top eight qualifiers of the year and is scheduled to take place at the Indian Wells Tennis Garden from November 8 to 15, with the top two players from each round-robin group advancing to the semifinals.

Rybakina, who enters the tournament as the defending champion, will begin her title defense against Gauff, four-time WTA participant Jessica Pegula, and tournament debutant Linda Noskova, who holds the reigning Wimbledon title. Sabalenka's group features 19-year-old Andreeva, 2018 WTA Finals champion Elina Svitolina, and Czech player Karolina Muchova. Group play will determine the semifinalists for the prestigious year-end event.

Reflecting on her status, Rybakina noted that achieving the world number one ranking following the US Open in September brought both heightened public scrutiny and increased motivation. She emphasized the continuous hard work required in the sport to maintain success under pressure. Sabalenka aims for redemption at the tournament after relinquishing her top ranking to Rybakina at the conclusion of the US Open, having earlier secured victories at both Indian Wells and Miami.

The tournament relocation to Indian Wells was announced by organizers in July, shifting the event from Riyadh following the early conclusion of the WTA's hosting agreement with Saudi Arabia. Players and fans prepare for a competitive week at the California venue as the tennis season reaches its conclusion.

stories.title: Iran Chief Negotiator Says US Voters Rejected War Following Midterms
stories.summary:
Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Iran’s chief negotiator in talks with the United States, stated on Wednesday that American voters delivered a definitive rejection of war following the Democratic midterm election victories. The elections resulted in Democrats capturing full control of Congress in a wave of upsets that served as a sharp rebuke to President Donald Trump.

The electoral shift reflected widespread public frustration over rising living costs, trade tariffs, and the ongoing military conflict with Iran, which has driven up fuel prices and intensified dissatisfaction with the administration. Ghalibaf shared this sentiment on the social media platform X, endorsing the public stance against the conflict.

The armed conflict was initially sparked by joint US-Israeli military strikes against Iran in February. Since then, the confrontation has largely remained deadlocked, characterized by sporadic exchanges of fire and persistent international anxieties regarding a potential escalation into full-scale warfare.

Ghalibaf issued a warning regarding future diplomatic relations, cautioning that if the US government ignores the will of its citizens to satisfy international pressures, it would face severe consequences from Tehran.

stories.title: BMW Lowers Outlook and Cuts Jobs Amid Weak China Market
stories.summary:
German car manufacturer BMW reported third-quarter pre-tax earnings of €2.1 billion, or approximately $2.36 billion. This figure represented an 11% decline compared to the previous year, matching predictions from analysts in a company-provided consensus. Meanwhile, the operating margin within the core automotive business contracted to 3.4%, which exceeded the projected 3.1% forecast by analysts but fell short of the 5.2% recorded during the same period a year earlier. CEO Milan Nedeljkovic emphasized that prevailing industry conditions demand decisiveness, prompting the company to accelerate and intensify its structural initiatives.

Reflecting these pressures, BMW revised its profit guidance for the second time in under five months. The company now anticipates a full-year core operating margin between -0.5% and 0.5%, a substantial drop from the double-digit margins achieved five years ago. This downward adjustment stems from anticipated fourth-quarter expenditures associated with an expansive restructuring program. Crucially, the strategy involves executing 8,000 layoffs within Germany.

In addition to workforce reductions, BMW aims to leverage the restructuring momentum to streamline management functions at an expedited pace. The company continues to navigate ongoing challenges originating from a weak performance in the Chinese market. These combined financial headwinds and operational changes highlight the mounting difficulties faced by the automobile maker as it prepares for the remainder of the fiscal year.

stories.title: UN Court to Issue Verdict on Myanmar Rohingya Genocide Case November 19
stories.summary:
The International Court of Justice (ICJ) in The Hague will deliver its ruling on November 19 regarding whether Myanmar's military crackdown against its Rohingya minority amounted to genocide. For seven years, judges have evaluated accusations brought by The Gambia that Myanmar violated the 1948 UN Genocide Convention through its brutal repression of the mostly Muslim population.

During hearings in January, Gambian Justice Minister Dawda Jallow argued that the Rohingya endured extreme violence and targeting for destruction, framing the issue as a collective international responsibility. Conversely, Myanmar has consistently denied any genocidal intent, maintaining that its security forces responded to a military uprising after insurgent attacks killed multiple security personnel. The 2017 military campaign and actions by Buddhist militias forced over a million Rohingya to flee into Bangladesh, creating the world's largest refugee settlement.

The upcoming verdict is being closely observed by legal experts for potential implications regarding other international disputes, such as South Africa's genocide case against Israel. While the ICJ lacks enforcement mechanisms, an adverse ruling would increase global pressure on Myanmar's leadership and provide a measure of accountability for victims. Myanmar's former civilian leader, Aung San Suu Kyi, previously rejected the allegations at the court in 2019, though she remains under house arrest following the 2021 military coup and will not attend the decision.

In separate developments connected to the region's ongoing conflicts, separate legal proceedings are underway at the International Criminal Court and in Argentina under universal jurisdiction. Meanwhile, domestic security operations continue in Pakistan, where police recently killed two members of a banned group in Lakki Marwat.

stories.title: Defending Champions Pakistan Ready for U19 Asia Cup Opener
stories.summary:
The ACC Men’s U19 Asia Cup 2026 kicks off in Oman on Thursday, November 5, with defending champions Pakistan scheduled to face the United Arab Emirates on Friday, November 6. The 50-over tournament features eight teams divided into two groups, with matches hosted at the Al Amerat Cricket Ground in Muscat. Pakistan is placed in Group A alongside the UAE, India, and Nepal, while Group B consists of Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, and Malaysia.

The tournament structure dictates that the top two teams from each group advance to the semi-finals on Thursday, November 12, ahead of the final on Saturday, November 14. Pakistan will be captained by Farhan Yousaf, who previously led the side to a 191-run victory over India in the previous edition's final at the ICC Cricket Academy Ground in Dubai. Following their opening fixture against the UAE, Pakistan will play India on November 8 and conclude their group matches against Nepal on November 10.

Speaking to PCB Digital, captain Farhan Yousaf expressed confidence in the team's preparations, noting that the board's decision to send the squad to Oman early proved beneficial for adapting to local weather, pitch conditions, and overall environment. He emphasized that the squad recognizes the responsibilities of being defending champions and is focused on maintaining consistency, high morale, and a winning mindset throughout the competition.

The Pakistan squad features players including Abdul Qadir, Abdul Subhan, Ahmed Hussain, Ali Raza, Hamza Zahoor, Hasnain Abbas Dar, Hayam Khan, Huzaifa Ahsan, Jahangir Bilal, Mohammad Huzaifa, Mohammad Seyam, Niqab Shafiq, and Rizwanullah. They are supported by a coaching and management team led by head coach and team manager Shahid Anwar, alongside specialist coaches for fast bowling, spin, and fielding.

stories.title: وفاقی کابینہ کا اجلاس: نئے کرنسی نوٹوں کے ڈیزائن کی منظوری
stories.summary:
وزیرِ اعظم شہباز شریف کی زیرِ صدارت وفاقی کابینہ کا ایک اہم اجلاس منعقد ہوا جس میں متعدد اہم انتظامی اور معاشی فیصلوں کی منظوری دی گئی۔ اجلاس میں خیبر پختونخوا میں گورننس بہتر بنانے کے لیے صوبے میں ایمرجنسی کی مدت کے دوران وزیر اعلیٰ کے روزمرہ امور کے اختیارات گورنر خیبر پختونخوا کو منتقل کرنے کی منظوری دی گئی۔ گورنر ہر ماہ اس حوالے سے وفاقی حکومت کو جائزہ رپورٹ پیش کریں گے۔

کابینہ نے وزارتِ خزانہ کی سفارش پر نئے کرنسی نوٹوں کے ڈیزائن کی بھی منظوری دے دی۔ اس حوالے سے بریفنگ میں بتایا گیا کہ ملک بھر کے ماہر ڈیزائنرز سے تجاویز لی گئیں اور وزیرِ اعظم کی کمیٹی نے مشاورت کی۔ جعلی نوٹوں کی روک تھام کے لیے جدید سیکیورٹی فیچرز اور نیا میٹریل استعمال کیا جائے گا جس سے نوٹوں کی عمر بھی بڑھے گی۔

مزید برآں، وفاقی کابینہ نے 10 روپے کے کاغذی بینک نوٹ کی جگہ 10 روپے کا سکہ متعارف کرانے کی بھی باضابطہ منظوری دی۔ اجلاس کے دوران پاکستان اور کویت کے درمیان 11 جون 2023 کو طے پانے والے دفاعی تعاون کے معاہدے کی بھی توثیق کی گئی، جس کا مقصد دونوں ممالک کے درمیان دفاعی تعلقات کو مزید فروغ دینا ہے۔

کابینہ نے مختلف کمیٹیوں جیسے کہ کابینہ کمیٹی برائے حکومتی ملکیتی اداروں اور کابینہ کمیٹی برائے لیجسلیٹیو کیسز کے پچھلے اجلاسوں میں کیے گئے فیصلوں کی بھی توثیق کی۔ حکومت کا یہ قدم ملکی معیشت، سیکیورٹی اور انتظامی امور میں بہتری لانے کی کوششوں کا حصہ ہے۔

stories.title: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed Wins Michigan Senate Seat to Make History
stories.summary:
Democrat Abdul El-Sayed announced his victory in the Michigan US Senate race early Wednesday morning, defeating former Republican lawmaker Mike Rogers. Addressing supporters at his election headquarters in Detroit, El-Sayed expressed pride in his successful campaign to represent the state in the upper chamber of Congress.

This electoral win marks a historic milestone, as El-Sayed becomes the first Muslim ever elected to the United States Senate. His triumph comes despite a late-campaign obstacle when congresswoman Haley Stevens, who had previously lost to El-Sayed in the primary, endorsed his Republican opponent late in the race.

The victory forms part of a broader political shift that saw Democrats capture Congress, delivering a significant setback to Donald Trump. El-Sayed's campaign focused on mobilizing voters in Michigan, ultimately securing the historic seat despite the eleventh-hour challenge from within his own party's primary rival.

stories.title: امریکہ میں وسط مدتی انتخابات کے پولنگ مکمل، نتائج آنے کا سلسلہ جاری
stories.summary:
امریکہ بھر میں وسط مدتی انتخابات کے لیے پولنگ کا عمل مکمل ہو چکا ہے اور اس کے بعد نتائج موصول ہونے کا سلسلہ جاری ہے۔ ان اہم انتخابات کے دوران ایوانِ نمائندگان کی تمام 435 نشستوں اور سینیٹ کی 100 میں سے 35 نشستوں کے واسطے نئے اراکین کا چناؤ کیا گیا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ چند ریاستوں میں گورنر اور دیگر ریاستی عہدوں کے لیے بھی رائے دہی کا عمل انجام پایا۔

ان انتخابی نتائج سے یہ فیصلہ ہونا ہے کہ آیا ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کی ریپبلکن پارٹی یا پھر مخالف ڈیموکریٹک پارٹی میں سے کون سا سیاسی گروہ کانگریس پر مکمل کنٹرول حاصل کرے گا۔ یہ نتائج صدر کے لیے آئندہ کے تمام سیاسی منصوبوں کو عملی جامہ پہنانے کی راہ میں حائل رکاوٹوں کا بھی تعین کریں گے۔

ابتدائی طور پر ڈیموکریٹک پارٹی کے حق میں کافی حوصلہ افزا رجحانات سامنے آئے ہیں، اور ماہرین کی جانب سے یہ پیش گوئی بھی کی جا رہی ہے کہ وہ دونوں ایوانوں یعنی سینیٹ اور ایوانِ نمائندگان میں اپنی اکثریت قائم کر کے کانگریس کا کنٹرول دوبارہ اپنے پاس واپس لے سکتے ہیں۔

اس انتخابی عمل اور اس کے نتائج پر ملک بھر کی نظریں مرکوز ہیں کیونکہ یہ آنے والے وقت میں ملکی سیاسی منظرنامے اور قانون سازی کے عمل پر گہرے اثرات مرتب کریں گے۔

stories.title: SSGC Releases Winter Gas Supply Schedule for Sindh and Balochistan
stories.summary:
The Sui Southern Gas Company (SSGC) has officially published its gas supply schedule for the winter season across Sindh and Balochistan, following directives from the federal government. Titled 'Managing Gas Load Effectively This Winter,' the plan details specific load management measures designed to handle high consumer demand during the colder months.

Under the utility's official timetable, gas distribution is concentrated around traditional meal times to prioritize domestic users. Supplies are designated to run from 6:30 am to 9:00 am for breakfast, 12:00 pm to 2:30 pm for lunch, and 6:00 pm to 9:00 pm for dinner. Previously, these three specific windows were informally communicated to media representatives by public relations officials rather than announced publicly by the company.

The formal announcement arrives in the wake of severe gas shortages reported across parts of Karachi, where residents noted a complete lack of supply and low pressure during designated breakfast hours. Many local families experienced difficulties in preparing meals as stoves remained dry despite the notified time slots.

While round-the-clock gas service has been absent for residents in Karachi for multiple years, the utility maintains that the newly structured load management framework is essential. The schedule aims to regulate consumption levels effectively across the region as winter weather drives up overall energy demands.

stories.title: خضدار میں معروف تاجر کا اغوا، شہریوں کا زیرو پوائنٹ پر احتجاجی دھرنا
stories.summary:
بلوچستان کے شہر خضدار کے علاقے غلامانی چوک سے نامعلوم مسلح افراد نے معروف تاجر اور قبائلی رہنما میر بہاول خان غلامانی کو ان کی دکان سے اغوا کر لیا۔ اس لرزہ خیز واقعے کے بعد مقامی پولیس نے فوری طور پر مقدمہ درج کر کے واقعے کی تفتیش اور مغوی کی بازیابی کے لیے کارروائی کا آغاز کر دیا ہے۔

اس اغوا کے خلاف تاجر کے اہلِ خانہ، علاقہ مکینوں اور مقامی شہریوں کی بڑی تعداد نے خضدار زیرو پوائنٹ پر قومی شاہراہ کو ہر قسم کی ٹریفک کے لیے مکمل طور پر بند کر دیا۔ مظاہرین نے سڑک پر دھرنا دے دیا اور نعرے بازی کرتے ہوئے مطالبہ کیا کہ میر بہاول خان غلامانی کو فوری طور پر بازیاب کروایا جائے اور ملوث ملزمان کو جلد از جلد گرفتار کیا جائے۔

شاہراہ کی طویل بندش کے باعث قومی شاہراہ کے دونوں اطراف گاڑیوں کی لمبی قطاریں لگ گئیں، جس سے مسافروں اور ٹرانسپورٹرز کو شدید مشکلات کا سامنا کرنا پڑا۔ احتجاج کرنے والوں کا کہنا تھا کہ تاجروں کا تحفظ حکومت کی ذمہ داری ہے اور اس طرح کے واقعات کسی صورت برداشت نہیں کیے جائیں گے۔

پولیس اور ضلعی انتظامیہ کے حکام مظاہرین سے مذاکرات کرنے اور شاہراہ کو ٹریفک کے لیے بحال کرنے کی کوششوں میں مصروف ہیں۔ دوسری جانب قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں نے مغوی کی بازیابی کے لیے چھاپے مارنے اور مسلح افراد کی تلاش کا دائرہ کار بڑھا دیا ہے۔

stories.title: Organisational Lapses Disrupt Teams Ahead of SAFF Cup Kick-off
stories.summary:
The SAFF Cup 2026 is set to begin in Dhaka on Thursday, but tournament organisers have already faced scrutiny over administrative and accommodation issues for arriving teams. A well-placed source confirmed that the Pakistan national team’s hotel was changed prior to their departure from Islamabad on Tuesday. Coached by Nolberto Solano, the squad arrived in Bangladesh early Wednesday morning following a journey through Qatar, ahead of their opening tournament fixture.

Concurrently, media reports surfaced indicating that the Indian team experienced significant delays in securing accommodation upon landing in Dhaka. After a slight flight delay, the team arrived at approximately 2:15 pm and was directed to a private hotel on Gulshan Avenue, only to find that rooms had not been allocated. Indian players reportedly waited several hours before finally securing their lodging late in the afternoon, sparking discussion on social media regarding the treatment of the defending champions.

On the field, the tournament features six teams divided into two groups, with Nepal absent due to a suspension. Pakistan, India, and Maldives form Group B, while hosts Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, and Bhutan comprise Group A. The top two teams from each group will progress to the semi-finals on November 14, culminating in the final on November 17. India is fielding an under-23 second-string squad for the competition.

Pakistan head coach Nolberto Solano highlighted the high stakes of the upcoming match against India, comparing its intensity to the fierce rivalry between Peru and Chile. Solano stressed that the team is taking a step-by-step approach, treating every match like a final as they target qualification for the knockout stages. Pakistan has never won the tournament, with their best finish being third place in the 1997 edition.

stories.title: Vietnam State Treasury Raises $419.7 Million in Weekly Bond Auction
stories.summary:
Vietnam's State Treasury successfully secured 10.8 trillion dong, which equates to $419.7 million, during its weekly government bond auction on Wednesday. This financial outcome indicates a reduction compared to the previous week, when a revised total of $874 million was raised by the treasury in Hanoi.

Data obtained from a filing with the Hanoi Stock Exchange indicates that the auction experienced a minor decline in participation. Specifically, the uptake for this latest session reached 86% of the total government bonds offered to the market, dropping slightly from the 87% uptake recorded during the preceding week.

This regular auction serves as part of the ongoing financial management strategies utilized by the Vietnamese government. The weekly issuance provides crucial funding mechanisms for state operations through the capital markets.

Monitoring these consistent treasury events offers insight into domestic liquidity and investor demand for sovereign debt instruments within the region. Financial analysts track these weekly fluctuations to gauge broader economic trends in Vietnam.

stories.title: Democrat Amy Acton Defeats Republican Vivek Ramaswamy in Ohio Governor Race
stories.summary:
Democratic candidate Amy Acton has won the gubernatorial race in the midwestern state of Ohio, defeating billionaire Republican opponent Vivek Ramaswamy, according to media projections on Tuesday. The 60-year-old Acton is a medical doctor by profession and previously directed Ohio’s health department during the early stages of the Covid-19 pandemic.

The high-stakes contest drew intense national attention and turned deeply controversial due to a political attack ad launched by Ramaswamy's campaign. The advertisement featured Acton’s estranged mother, Donna Arthur, who claimed her daughter had lied throughout her life and was unfit for office. In response, Acton revealed publicly that she and her brother had suffered severe abuse, hunger, and neglect during childhood, disclosing that she was sexually abused by her mother's husband between the ages of 10 and 12 while her mother failed to intervene.

Although Ohio has leaned heavily Republican in recent elections—with President Donald Trump winning the state by double digits in 2024—Acton ultimately secured the victory. Despite facing widespread bipartisan and public backlash over the contentious ad, Ramaswamy maintained the endorsement of President Trump, who blamed the media for a coordinated attack. Outgoing Republican Governor Mike DeWine, who was term-limited, joined Democrats in criticizing the advertisement.

The race unfolds against a broader political backdrop where Democrats captured Congress in what media outlets described as a sweeping setback for Trump's party. Acton stated that she had not seen her mother since 1978 and criticized Ramaswamy for exploiting family trauma for political advancement.

stories.title: Two Militants Killed in Police Operation in Pakistan's Lakki Marwat District
stories.summary:
Two suspected terrorists, including an individual identified as a suicide bomber, were killed during an exchange of fire with law enforcement officers in the Lakki Marwat district of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on Wednesday. A third militant sustained injuries during the encounter but managed to evade capture, prompting authorities to initiate an extensive area search.

The operation began after police intelligence identified a suspicious vehicle featuring tinted windows operating within the Gandi Chowk area of Sarai Naurang tehsil. A substantial contingent of police personnel was dispatched to intercept the vehicle. Upon noticing the approaching authorities, the occupants attempted to flee while simultaneously opening fire on the police team, forcing officers to return fire.

According to official police statements, the deceased men belonged to the banned organization Fitna al-Khawarij. Investigators recovered weapons, prohibited items, women’s burqas, and a flag associated with a proscribed group directly from the bodies at the scene.

This incident follows prior security challenges in the region, including a June incident in the Khairokhel Pakka area where a motorcycle-borne suicide attacker was intercepted by a local peace committee near a mosque, resulting in an explosion that claimed two civilian lives and injured ten others.

stories.title: ترک خاتون کو تھپڑ مارنے کے واقعے سے متعلق وائرل دعویٰ بے بنیاد
stories.summary:
سوشل میڈیا پر حال ہی میں ایک ویڈیو بڑے پیمانے پر وائرل ہوئی ہے جس میں یہ دعویٰ کیا گیا تھا کہ لندن میں ایک پاکستانی شخص نے ترک سیاح خاتون کو سڑک پر بلاوجہ تھپڑ مار دیا ہے اور اسے گرفتار کر لیا گیا ہے۔ تاہم، کسی بھی مستند اور مصدقہ خبر یا رپورٹ میں اس بات کی تصدیق نہیں ہوئی کہ ملزم کا تعلق پاکستان سے تھا یا یہ واقعہ لندن میں پیش آیا تھا۔

ترک خبر رساں اداروں ڈیمیرورین نیوز ایجنسی، اناڈولوو ایجنسی اور آئی ایچ اے کی یکم نومبر 2026 کی رپورٹس کے مطابق یہ واقعہ دراصل ترکی میں پیش آیا تھا۔ یکم نومبر کو ترکی میں ایک مارکیٹ کے باہر 46 سالہ ترک خاتون کھڑی تھیں جب ایک شخص نے پیچھے سے آ کر ان کے بائیں کان پر زور دار تھپڑ مارا، جس سے خاتون کی سماعت بھی متاثر ہوئی۔

ترک پولیس نے سی سی ٹی وی کیمرے کی مدد سے فوری کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ملزم کی شناخت 38 سالہ تولگا چیلیک (Tolga Çelik) کے نام سے کی، جس کا پہلے سے چھ مختلف جرائم کا کریمینل ریکارڈ موجود ہے۔ گرفتار ملزم نے پولیس کے سامنے موقف اپنایا تھا کہ اس کا ہاتھ غلطی سے خاتون کو لگا تھا، لیکن عدالت نے اسے جان بوجھ کر خاتون کو زخمی کرنے کے جرم میں جیل بھیج دیا۔

اس تمام مصدقہ معلومات سے واضح ہوتا ہے کہ سوشل میڈیا پر اس واقعے کو لندن سے منسوب کرنا اور ملزم کو پاکستانی قرار دینا سراسر غلط، غیر مصدقہ اور گمراہ کن پروپیگنڈا ہے۔ عوام کو اس طرح کی جھوٹی خبروں اور فیک ویڈیوز کو بغیر تحقیق آگے شیئر کرنے سے گریز کرنا چاہیے۔

stories.title: Top Iranian Negotiator Says US Election Results Show Americans Reject War
stories.summary:
Iran’s chief negotiator in diplomatic talks with the United States, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, stated on Wednesday that recent US midterm election outcomes demonstrate that the American public has voted "NO TO WAR." The comments follow a political shift where Democrats defeated Republicans to secure full control of the US Congress.

Ghalibaf asserted that the electoral results served as a direct rebuke of President Donald Trump and his administration, driven by voter frustration regarding escalating living costs, tariffs, and the ongoing military conflict with Iran. The confrontation, which escalated following US-Israeli strikes on Iran in February, has caused fuel prices to soar and heightened domestic discontent within the United States.

Highlighting the public sentiment expressed through the ballot box, Ghalibaf warned the American leadership against ignoring the will of their constituents. He indicated that Tehran fully endorses the anti-war message delivered by voters during the midterms.

Furthermore, the Iranian negotiator cautioned that if the US government disregards public opinion to satisfy international pressures, it would face severe consequences. The diplomatic standoff continues amidst a stagnant military conflict and lingering fears of renewed hostilities.

stories.title: Minority candidates secure historic leadership firsts in US midterm elections
stories.summary:
The United States midterm elections featured several historic electoral milestones, with voters delivering a sharp rejection of President Donald Trump’s second term and helping Democrats achieve sweeping wins. Bill Shiebler, chief strategy officer at the non-profit advocacy network State Voices, described the outcome as a significant rebuke against division and a sign of a multiracial democracy functioning properly.

In Georgia, Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms won the gubernatorial race by defeating billionaire health care executive Rick Jackson. This victory makes her the first Black woman elected governor of any US state and returns the governor’s office to Democrats after over twenty years of Republican control. Meanwhile, in New Hampshire, Democratic Representative Chris Pappas won election to the US Senate, becoming the first openly gay man to serve in that body.

Additional historic wins occurred in New Mexico, where Democrat Deb Haaland became the first Native American woman elected governor after defeating Republican Gregg Hull. Haaland previously served as the Secretary of the Interior under former president Joe Biden. In Michigan, leftist Abdul El-Sayed pursued a high-profile bid to become the first Muslim elected to the US Senate. State-level results also featured Gina Hinojosa becoming Texas's first Latina governor.

Looking forward, House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries is expected to vie for the speakership in the new Congress, which would make him the first Black speaker of the House in American history. Shiebler noted that the election reflected a populace choosing to believe in the promise of the country rather than allowing voices to be suppressed.

stories.title: New Zealand dollar dips on weak employment data as Australian dollar faces pressure
stories.summary:
The New Zealand dollar dropped to a three-week low on Wednesday following weak employment data that diminished expectations of a near-term interest rate hike. Meanwhile, the Australian dollar sustained losses as a dovish shift by its central bank signaled that interest rates may have peaked.

In New Zealand, government data revealed that the jobless rate climbed to 5.7% in the third quarter, reaching its highest level since 2015, while employment unexpectedly fell. This followed a surprise policy hold by the Reserve Bank of New Zealand just the previous week. Consequently, two-year swap rates dropped 9 basis points to 3.7519%, marking an eight-week low, and markets reduced the probability of an October rate hike to 57% from nearly 80%. Analysts at Citi Australia stated they no longer anticipate further tightening and expect the official cash rate to remain at 2.75% for an extended period.

Across the Tasman Sea, the Reserve Bank of Australia raised its cash rate to an 18-year high in its fifth hike of the year. However, a narrow 6-3 vote and the removal of its tightening bias indicated an end to rapid policy tightening. UBS chief economist George Tharenou noted that the risk of an additional hike has decreased and expects the cash rate to hold steady at 4.85% until late 2027.

Amid these regional developments, currency markets also monitored the US midterm elections, where expectations of a strong Democratic showing led investors to sell the US dollar. This dynamic helped the New Zealand dollar and Australian dollar recover some of their earlier losses during the trading session.

stories.title: Police Fire Tear Gas at Protesting Teachers Marching in Karachi
stories.summary:
Sindh police deployed tear gas shells and a water cannon on Wednesday to disperse protesting primary school teachers who were marching toward the Chief Minister's House in Karachi. The demonstration, organised by the Primary School Teachers Association representing various districts of Sindh, began with a sit-in outside the Karachi Press Club before participants attempted to approach the government headquarters. Several demonstrators were detained during the clashes.

The police intervention caused significant disruption in the area, forcing the closure of roads surrounding the press club as well as Sir Syed Road. Traffic police redirected vehicles toward Aiwan-e-Sadr Road and Zainab Market, while the use of tear gas also impacted employees working in nearby offices. The protest highlighted persistent grievances regarding employment conditions and administrative policies within the education sector.

The protesting educators are demanding the restoration of their service structure and pay grade upgrades, pointing out that promised advancements have stalled for years. Their key demands include granting permanent status from the dates of initial appointments, decentralising the transfer policy to the district level rather than handling it through the Sindh Secretariat, and abolishing the Cluster Hub Policy. They also called for the immediate withdrawal of plans to merge smaller government schools into larger institutions, arguing that such measures harm the overall education system. The teachers stated that their demonstrations and sit-in will persist until all demands are formally met.

stories.title: North Korea launches unidentified projectile off east coast following naval shipyard visit
stories.summary:
North Korea launched an unidentified projectile toward the sea off its east coast on Wednesday, according to South Korea's Defence Ministry. This action represents the latest military display by Pyongyang amid a busy year of weapons tests that have included hypersonic missiles and a missile flight exceeding 900 kilometers.

The launch announcement arrived just hours after Kim Yo Jong, the influential sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, dismissed the possibility of dialogue with Washington. She stated that the United States must first abandon its hostile policy and reiterated denials regarding North Korean involvement in a crypto exchange Binance hacking incident, countering accusations made by the FBI.

Prior to the projectile launch, state media reported that Kim Jong Un inspected a naval shipyard constructing a destroyer, where he underscored the necessity of maintaining a powerful naval force. Lee Choon-geun, a missile expert and board member at the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, noted that the high frequency of missile tests suggests Pyongyang might be nearing mass production stages or preparing weapons for export to Russia.

stories.title: Japanese Nikkei tumbles 3% as US midterm Democratic gains weigh on AI stocks
stories.summary:
Japan’s Nikkei average experienced a sharp decline on Wednesday, dropping 3.1% to 61,127.9 by mid-morning, while the broader Topix index fell 1.85% to 3,857.97. The downturn was largely driven by losses in AI-related stocks due to market anxiety over potential Democratic gains in the US midterm elections.

Investors grew cautious that a stronger Democratic presence in the US Congress could result in stricter government regulations on artificial intelligence infrastructure projects and slower spending in the sector. Takamasa Ikeda, a senior portfolio manager at GCI Asset Management, pointed out that election outcomes in key states fueled concerns about heightened regulatory oversight on AI investments.

In response, Japanese technology shares suffered significant losses. Chip-testing equipment manufacturer Advantest fell 6.4%, Tokyo Electron dropped 5%, and technology investor SoftBank Group slipped approximately 7%. Manufacturers of fiber-optic cables essential for data centers also retreated, with Fujikura and Furukawa Electric declining 8.2% and 9% respectively. Prediction markets indicated mounting expectations of a Democratic sweep, with over $1.48 billion wagered on the midterm outcomes, contributing to a broader market breadth where 130 of the Nikkei's 225 components declined.

stories.title: China's yuan falls to two-week low following foreign reserve requirement hike
stories.summary:
China’s yuan dropped to a more than two-week low against the dollar on Wednesday following a central bank decision to raise foreign currency reserve requirements. The onshore yuan decreased to 6.6832 per dollar in morning trades, marking its weakest level since October 19, before trading at 6.6794 at 0303 GMT. The offshore currency also weakened by approximately 0.13% in Asian trade to fetch 6.6782 per dollar.

The sudden market shift occurred after the People’s Bank of China announced on Tuesday that it would increase the foreign exchange reserve requirement ratio (RRR) by 2 percentage points, moving it from 4% to 6%. Analysts and currency traders described the move as a major effort to curb the yuan's sustained rally, which has seen the currency strengthen by about 5% over the course of the year. SEB head of Asia strategy Eugenia Victorino stated that the central bank is applying the brakes to a rising currency.

Prior to Wednesday's market opening, the People’s Bank of China established the official midpoint rate at 6.7180 per dollar, which is 369 pips weaker than a Reuters estimate of 6.6811 and represents the weakest level since October 23. Market observers noted that the central bank's daily guidance rates have consistently been weaker than market expectations this year, signaling an intent to manage the pace of the currency's appreciation. Based on this official guidance, the CFETS yuan basket index declined to 103.75 from a 52-month high on Tuesday, though it remains up roughly 5.9% for the year.

Simultaneously, financial markets monitored the ongoing US midterm elections and their potential influence on global currency markets, with investors positioning for a strong Democratic showing. The combination of monetary policy adjustments and international political events has created heightened activity across regional financial sectors as participants evaluate future market directions.

stories.title: گورنر راج کے نفاذ کے بعد خیبر پختونخوا میں تاجروں کی احتجاجی تحریک معطل
stories.summary:
خیبر پختون خوا میں ایمرجنسی اور گورنر راج کے نفاذ کے بعد ملاکنڈ ڈویژن میں ٹیکسوں کے خلاف جاری تاجروں کی احتجاجی تحریک عارضی طور پر خاموش ہو گئی ہے۔ ڈویژن بھر کے تاجر اور عوام اب وزیراعظم کی جانب سے قائم کردہ کمیٹی کے حتمی فیصلے کے منتظر ہیں۔

ملاکنڈ ڈویژن کے اضلاع شانگلہ، سوات، بونیر، باجوڑ، ملاکنڈ، اور چترال سمیت دیگر علاقوں میں یکم جولائی سے نافذ ٹیکسوں کو مسترد کیا گیا تھا۔ مختلف تجارتی تنظیموں، ہوٹل ایسوسی ایشنز، ٹرانسپورٹرز اور بارگینز مالکان کی جانب سے اس سلسلے میں احتجاجی مظاهرے کیے گئے تھے اور سوات ایکسپریس وے ٹول پلازہ سمیت شاہراہ قراقرم کو بند کرنے کا اعلان بھی کیا گیا تھا۔

صوبے میں گورنر راج نافذ ہونے کے بعد تمام احتجاجی سرگرمیاں موخر کر دی گئی ہیں جس سے ٹیکس مخالف تحریک کی رفتار بھی دھیمی پڑ گئی ہے۔ تاجروں اور عوام کا کہنا ہے کہ وہ وزیرِ اعظم کی کمیٹی کی طرف دیکھ رہے ہیں تاکہ ان کے مطالعہ اور تحفظات کا ازالہ ہو سکے۔

عوامی حلقوں نے وفاقی حکومت سے پرزور مطالبہ کیا ہے کہ ملاکنڈ ڈویژن کی خصوصی حیثیت بحال کی جائے اور یکم جولائی سے عائد کیے جانے والے تمام ٹیکس ختم کیے جائیں تاکہ علاقے میں پائی جانے والی بے چینی اور احتجاج کا مستقل خاتمہ ہو سکے۔

stories.title: کراچی شارع فیصل پر تیز رفتار ڈالے کی غفلت سے اسکول وین کو حادثہ
stories.summary:
کراچی کے اہم ترین راستے شارع فیصل پر ناتھا خان پل کے قریب ایک تیز رفتار ریوو ڈالے کی غفلت کی وجہ سے بچوں کی اسکول وین کو ایک خوفناک حادثہ پیش آیا ہے۔ اس حادثے میں متعدد گاڑیاں آپس میں ٹکرا گئیں جس کے نتیجے میں کُل چار گاڑیوں کو نقصان پہنچا ہے۔

اس حادثے کا سبب بننے والے واقعے میں جب ایک کار سوار نے خود کو بچانے کے لیے اچانک بریک لگائی، تو اس کے نتیجے میں پچھلی گاڑیاں ایک دوسرے سے جا ٹکرائیں۔ تیز رفتار ویگو ڈالے نے اپنے آگے موجود گاڑی کو بری طرح دبایا، جس کے باعث اسکول وین کو شدید نقصان اٹھانا پڑا۔

حادثے کے وقت اسکول وین کے اندر دو سال سے لے کر آٹھ سال تک کی عمر کے معصوم بچے اور بچیاں سوار تھے۔ اس خوفناک تصادم کی وجہ سے وین کا اگلا حصہ اور ڈرائیونگ سائیڈ کا دروازہ مکمل طور پر تباہ ہو گیا، اور بچے شدید خوفزدہ ہو کر رونے لگے۔

خوش قسمتی سے وین کے ڈرائیور کی بروقت حاضر دماغی کی بدولت اس میں سوار تمام بچے معجزانہ طور پر محفوظ رہے اور کسی بڑے جانی نقصان سے بچ گئے۔ واقعے کے فوراً بعد سڑک پر موجود عام شہریوں نے موقع پر پہنچ کر بچوں کو بحفاظت گاڑی سے باہر نکالا۔

stories.title: Chinese stock markets trade near one-year lows despite recent government support
stories.summary:
Chinese stock markets hovered near one-year lows on Wednesday despite the introduction of fresh government support measures aimed at stabilizing the financial sector. Market participants maintained a cautious stance while simultaneously preparing for the results of the US midterm elections. By the midday break, the blue-chip CSI300 Index, the Shanghai Composite Index, and Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Index all remained relatively flat.

On Wednesday, China's central bank reported that commercial banks applied to borrow over 200 billion yuan, equivalent to $29.98 billion, to finance share purchases by listed companies under an upgraded re-lending scheme. This development followed a People's Bank of China operation on Tuesday involving 100 billion yuan worth of swaps with brokers and fund companies to support share buying. These actions formed part of a broader package announced by Beijing late on Monday to halt a severe market decline, making the Chinese market one of the world's worst-performing indices this year.

 Investor confidence has been severely damaged by ongoing economic weakness and a sharp fall in technology shares, which caused the CSI300 to plunge 8.5% in October, marking its worst monthly performance since early 2016. Wu Weizhi, founder of Zhong Ou Rabbit Asset Management, explained that battered markets require time to heal following over-crowded trades that triggered a stampede in tech stocks, though he noted that numerous positive signals are emerging in sectors that have experienced steep drops in value.

Additionally, investors watched the US midterm elections closely due to potential implications for Washington's relationship with China and artificial intelligence policies. China Galaxy Securities warned that Chinese companies deriving most of their revenue from the US could face impacts from political shifts, while Hong Kong markets remain vulnerable to global volatility tied to the results. On Wednesday, domestic AI-related stocks rose following an overnight rebound in US chip shares, though declines in real estate and telecom sectors weighed on the broader mainland market, while biotech gains countered tech and property losses in Hong Kong.

stories.title: SSGC implements winter gas supply schedule alongside unrelated legal and security developments
stories.summary:
The Sui Southern Gas Company Limited (SSGC) has introduced a dedicated gas supply schedule for domestic consumers during the winter season to prioritize household needs, following directives from the Government of Pakistan. Under the new arrangement, gas will be supplied across three distinct time slots to support daily meal preparation. Consumers will receive gas for breakfast from 6:30 am to 9:00 am, for lunch between 12:00 pm and 2:30 pm, and for dinner from 6:00 pm to 9:00 pm.

SSGC stated that this initiative is designed to maintain a steady and managed gas supply for household cooking throughout the winter months. Consumers have been encouraged to plan their cooking schedules around these designated hours. For assistance or complaints, the public can reach out to the company via its official website or through the SSGC helpline at 1199.

In a separate legal development, a Karachi court ordered SSGC to pay Rs30 million in damages to Alizeh, the daughter of a couple who tragically died in a gas pipeline explosion in Orangi Town in 2022. The Senior Civil Judge (West) found the company negligent for failing to repair the pipeline despite repeated warnings regarding gas leaks in the neighborhood. The plaintiff, represented by Advocate Usman Farooq, had initially filed a lawsuit seeking Rs90 million in compensation for the maintenance failures of the gas utility.

Additionally, security forces in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's Lakki Marwat district engaged in an exchange of fire during a police operation, resulting in the deaths of two terrorists. Police launched the raid in the Gandi Chowk area, successfully eliminating two members of the banned group Fitna al-Khawarij, which included a designated suicide bomber. The operation added to a series of notable regional events reported alongside the utility updates.

stories.title: پاکستان ریلوے نے مقامی سکھ اور ہندو یاتریوں کے لیے خصوصی ٹرینوں کا شیڈول جاری کر دیا
stories.summary:
پاکستان ریلوے کی جانب سے ہر سال کی روایت برقرار رکھتے ہوئے مقامی سکھ اور ہندو یاتریوں کے لیے دو خصوصی ٹرینوں کا شیڈول جاری کر دیا گیا ہے۔ یہ فیصلہ ننکانہ صاحب میں سالانہ مذہبی تقریبات میں شرکت کے لیے یاتریوں کو سفری سہولیات فراہم کرنے کی غرض سے کیا گیا ہے۔

ترجمان ریلویز کے مطابق پہلی سکھ اسپیشل ٹرین بیس نومبر کو حیدرآباد سے ننکانہ صاحب جبکہ دوسری اسپیشل ٹرین پچیس نومبر کو ننکانہ صاحب سے حیدرآباد کے درمیان چلائی جائے گی۔ اس کے علاوہ دو شٹل ٹرینیں بھی چلانے کا فیصلہ کیا گیا ہے۔

یہ خصوصی ٹرین خانیوال، فیصل آباد، شیخوپورہ، ٹنڈو آدم، شہدادپور، نواب شاہ، روہڑی اور گھوٹکی سمیت مختلف ریلوے اسٹیشنوں سے گزرے گی۔ لاڑکانہ سے روہڑی کے درمیان بھی سکھ اور ہندو یاتریوں کے لیے دو خصوصی شٹل ٹرینیں بیس اور چھبیس نومبر کو چلائی جائیں گی۔

ریلوے حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ پاکستان ریلوے کی جانب سے خصوصی ٹرینیں چلانے کا یہ اقدام اقلیتی برادری کو سفری سہولیات کی فراہمی کی جانب ایک اہم پیش رفت ہے۔

stories.title: شرجیل میمن نے یونیورسٹی روڈ پر ریڈ لائن بی آر ٹی کے یو ٹرن کھولنے کی ہدایت دیدی
stories.summary:
سندھ کے سینئر وزیر شرجیل انعام میمن کی زیر صدارت محکمہ ٹرانسپورٹ و ماس ٹرانزٹ کا ایک اہم اجلاس منعقد ہوا۔ اجلاس میں سیکریٹری ٹرانسپورٹ اسد ضامن، سی ای او ٹرانس کراچی زبیر چنہ، پی ڈی یلو لائن کمال دایو اور دیگر متعلقہ حکام نے شرکت کی۔

اجلاس کے دوران سینئر صوبائی وزیر شرجیل میمن نے یونیورسٹی روڈ پر ریڈ لائن بی آر ٹی کے یو ٹرن کھولنے کی ہدایت کی۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ ریڈ لائن بی آر ٹی منصوبے کی بروقت تکمیل کے لیے غیر معمولی اقدامات کیے جانے چاہئیں۔

شرجیل میمن نے امید ظاہر کی کہ مزید ڈبل ڈیکر اور الیکٹرک بسوں کی کھیپ جلد کراچی پہنچ جائے گی۔ انہوں نے ہدایت کی کہ ان بسوں کے آپریشن کے لیے روٹس، چارجنگ اسٹیشنز، ڈپو، بس اسٹاپس اور دیگر تکنیکی و انتظامی انتظامات کو حتمی شکل دی جائے۔

انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ آپریشنز اور سروسز سمیت تمام متعلقہ امور کے لیے جامع منصوبہ بندی کی جائے اور کوشش کی جائے کہ ڈبل ڈیکر اور الیکٹرک بسیں شہر کے ان حصوں تک پہنچیں جہاں عوام کو پبلک ٹرانسپورٹ کی سب سے زیادہ ضرورت ہے۔

stories.title: Nasa's Swift satellite telescope re-enters Earth's atmosphere after 22 years in orbit
stories.summary:
An aging Nasa satellite telescope that was targeted for a failed retrieval mission earlier this summer re-entered Earth's atmosphere on Wednesday in a fiery descent, nearly 22 years after its initial launch. Weighing approximately 3,200 pounds or 1,452 kilograms, the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory tumbled out of orbit and burned up over the tropics. Nasa confirmed that any surviving fragments falling back to Earth posed virtually no threat to populated areas.

The US Space Force estimated the probability of anyone on Earth suffering harm at one in 2,100, according to a Nasa statement that projected the re-entry time around 3:30 am EST, or 0830 GMT. Meanwhile, The Aerospace Corporation estimated a re-entry window of 5:19 am EST with a two-hour margin, and London-based astrophysicist Jonathan McDowell cited revised Space Force data pointing to a re-entry near 7:45 am EST as the satellite skimmed the upper atmosphere in a circular orbit.

Valued at $500 million, the multi-wavelength Swift space observatory had been studying gamma-ray bursts and various cosmic phenomena since 2004 utilizing three onboard telescopes. Because the observatory lacked an independent propulsion system, it drifted downward over several months while circling the globe at roughly 17,000 miles per hour, or 27,359 kilometers per hour. Astronomers had hoped to prolong the mission by using a specialized rescue spacecraft named LINK, launched in July by Nasa and Arizona-based startup Katalyst, to latch onto Swift and elevate it into a sustainable orbit.

However, the rescue effort was abandoned by mid-August after the LINK spacecraft began spinning uncontrollably shortly after reaching space. The aborted rescue attempt served as a high-profile demonstration of new orbital grappling technology relevant to the US-China space race and potential military space applications. Originally designed for a two-year prime mission to explore powerful gamma-ray radiation bursts from distant galaxies, Swift far exceeded its planned lifespan by observing supermassive black holes, X-ray flares, comets, and asteroids.

stories.title: کائلی جینر نے بڑی بہن کینڈل جینر کی اکتیسویں سالگرہ پر محبت بھرا پیغام شیئر کر دیا
stories.summary:
امریکی ماڈل کینڈل جینر کی اکتیسویں سالگرہ کے موقع پر ان کی چھوٹی بہن اور معروف کاروباری شخصیت کائلی جینر نے ایک محبت بھرا پیغام شیئر کرکے مداحوں کے دل جیت لیے ہیں۔ اس خوبصورت موقع پر کائلی نے انسٹاگرام کا رخ کیا۔

کائلی جینر نے انسٹاگرام پر اپنی بہن کے ساتھ بچپن کی دلکش تصاویر بھی اپ لوڈ کیں، جن کے ذریعے انہوں نے دونوں کے درمیان گزرے ہوئے یادگار اور پرانے لمحات کو ایک بار پھر تازہ کیا۔

اپنے جذباتی کیپشن میں کائلی جینر نے لکھا کہ آج وہ جو کچھ بھی ہیں، اس میں ان کی بہن کا ان کے ساتھ ہونے اور ان کے کردار کا ایک بہت بڑا حصہ شامل ہے۔

بہن کی جانب سے ملنے والے اس محبت بھرے اور جذباتی پیغام کو دیکھ کر کینڈل جینر بھی جذباتی ہو گئیں اور انہوں نے کمنٹس کے خانے میں آنسوؤں والے ایموجیز کے ذریعے اپنے جذبات کا کھل کر اظہار کیا۔

stories.title: پاکستان پوسٹ آفس میں مبینہ غیر قانونی بھرتیاں، نیب نے اسعد محمود کو طلب کر لیا
stories.summary:
قومی احتساب بیورو (نیب) راولپنڈی نے جمعیت علمائے اسلام ف کے رہنما اور سابق وفاقی وزیرِ مواصلات اسعد محمود کو پاکستان پوسٹ آفس میں مبینہ غیر قانونی بھرتیوں کے معاملے پر طلب کر لیا ہے۔ انہیں 10 نومبر کو صبح 11 بجے نیب کے سامنے پیش ہونے کا نوٹس جاری کیا گیا ہے۔

یہ تحقیقات اسعد محمود کے دورِ وزارت (2022ء سے 2023ء) کے دوران پاکستان پوسٹ آفس میں ہونے والی مبینہ بے ضابطگیوں کے سلسلے میں کی جا رہی ہیں۔ نیب کے نوٹس کے مطابق اسٹیبلشمنٹ ڈویژن نے 3 ہزار 938 اسامیوں کی منظوری دی تھی لیکن مبینہ طور پر 4 ہزار 252 افراد کو بھرتی کیا گیا۔

نیب کی جانب سے عائد کردہ الزامات میں کہا گیا ہے کہ کابینہ کمیٹی کی ہدایات کے برعکس 2 ہزار 646 ختم شدہ اسامیوں پر بھی بھرتیاں کی گئیں۔ اس کے علاوہ ٹیسٹنگ ایجنسی کے ذریعے کنٹریکٹ پر بھرتیوں کی سفارش کے باوجود مستقل تقرریاں کی گئیں اور بوگس دستاویزات، زائد العمر امیدواروں اور ڈومیسائل کوٹے کی خلاف ورزی کے معاملات بھی سامنے آئے۔

نیب نے تنبیہ کی ہے کہ طلبی کے اس نوٹس پر عمل نہ کرنے کی صورت میں قومی احتساب آرڈیننس 1999ء کی دفعہ 31 کے تحت قانونی کارروائی عمل میں لائی جائے گی۔ اس سے قبل وفاقی تحقیقاتی ادارے (ایف آئی اے) کے اینٹی کرپشن سرکل اسلام آباد نے بھی انہیں 2 نومبر کو بیان ریکارڈ کرانے کے لیے نوٹس جاری کیا تھا۔

stories.title: غازان خان کا قبول اسلام اور منگول سلطنت کی تاریخ پر اثرات
stories.summary:
سنہ 1295 کے موسمِ گرما میں ایران کے شمال میں البُرز کے پہاڑی علاقے داماوند کے لار میدان میں ایک تاریخی تقریب منعقد ہوئی۔ اس موقع پر چنگیز خان کی پانچویں پشت سے تعلق رکھنے والے اور ہلاکو خان کے پڑپوتے غازان خان نے باضابطہ طور پر اسلام قبول کرنے کا اعلان کیا۔ وہ اس وقت خراسان کے گورنر اور منگول سلطنت کی ایرانی شاخ ایلخانی سلطنت کے تخت کے ایک طاقتور امیدوار تھے۔

غازان خان 5 نومبر 1271 کو آبسکون میں پیدا ہوئے اور ان کے والد ارغون اور دادا اباقا بدھ مت کے پیروکار تھے، جس کی وجہ سے ان کی ابتدائی پرورش بھی اسی مذہب میں ہوئی تھی۔ اپنے سیاسی سفر میں کئی بغاوتوں اور کشمکش کے بعد، امیر نورُوز کے مشورے پر انہوں نے اسلام قبول کیا اور شیخ صدرالدین حَمَوی کی موجودگی میں کلمہ پڑھا۔ انہوں نے اپنا اسلامی نام محمود اور لقب معزالدین اختیار کیا۔

ان کے قبولِ اسلام کے بعد منگول امرا اور سپاہیوں میں بھی اسلام تیزی سے پھیلا، جس سے ایلخانی سلطنت کی شناخت ایک مسلم ریاست کے طور پر قائم ہوئی۔ ان کے دور میں مساجد، مدارس اور اسلامی اداروں کی تعمیر کو بہت فروغ ملا۔ اگرچہ انہوں نے ایک مسلم حکمران کی حیثیت سے حکومت کی، تاہم انہوں نے دیگر مذاہب کے ساتھ رواداری کا رویہ بھی برقرار رکھا۔

غازان خان تین نومبر 1295 کو تخت نشین ہوئے اور انہوں نے اپنے دور میں مملوکوں کے خلاف عسکری مہمات بھی جاری رکھیں۔ شام پر حملے کے دوران ان کی ملاقات ممتاز عالم ابن تیمیہ سے بھی ہوئی تھی۔ غازان خان کا یہ اقدام ذاتی عقیدے، سیاسی حکمتِ عملی اور منگول روایات کا ایک انوکھا امتزاج تھا۔

stories.title: لیبیا سے ڈی پورٹ ہونے والے بارہ پاکستانی شہریوں کے خلاف ایف آئی اے نے مقدمہ درج کر لیا
stories.summary:
راولپنڈی میں ایف آئی اے امیگریشن نے اسلام آباد ایئرپورٹ پر کارروائی کرتے ہوئے لیبیا سے ڈی پورٹ ہو کر آنے والے بارہ پاکستانی شہریوں کے خلاف باقاعدہ مقدمہ درج کر لیا ہے۔ تمام شہریوں کو کارروائی کے بعد ایف آئی اے اینٹی ہیومن ٹریفکنگ سرکل راولپنڈی منتقل کر دیا گیا ہے۔

ابتدائی تفتیش کے دوران یہ اہم انکشاف سامنے آیا ہے کہ ان شہریوں کو مختلف ایجنٹوں کی طرف سے بیرون ملک اچھی ملازمتوں کا جھانسہ دیا گیا تھا۔ اس فریب کے بعد انہیں وزٹ اور عمرہ ویزوں پر پاکستان سے پہلے دبئی اور مصر کے راستے لیبیا بھجوایا گیا تھا۔

ایف آئی اے کے مطابق ان تمام شہریوں کو لیبیا سے کشتیوں کے ذریعے غیر قانونی طور پر سمندر کے راستے اٹلی منتقل کرنے کی خطرناک کوشش کی گئی تھی۔ ملزم ایجنٹوں پر شہریوں سے بھاری رقوم بٹورنے اور غیر قانونی طور پر بیرون ملک بھیجنے کے سنگین الزامات عائد کیے گئے ہیں۔

مقدمے میں محمد عدنان حیدر، محمد جمال، نبیل احمد، ثاقب شبیر، محمد فیضان، سجاد محمود، محمد اخلاق، محمد انیس، روحیل تعمیر، رحمان خالد، ثاقب علی اور عارف حسین نامزد ہیں۔ اس مقدمے کی تفتیش انسپکٹر محمد عبداللہ کیانی کر رہے ہیں جبکہ دیگر ملوث عناصر کا کردار تفتیش کے دوران طے کیا جائے گا۔

stories.title: قوانین پر مؤثر عمل درآمد ہی کام کی جگہوں کا اصل چیلنج ہے، سعید غنی
stories.summary:
صوبائی وزیر محنت و افرادی قوت سندھ سعید غنی نے کراچی میں پاکستان ایکارڈ کے سالانہ پروگرام سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ حکومت سندھ مزدوروں کے حقوق کے تحفظ اور محفوظ ماحول فراہم کرنے کے لیے پرعزم ہے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ صرف قانون سازی کافی نہیں بلکہ اصل چیلنج قوانین پر مؤثر عمل درآمد ہے، جس کے لیے لیبر انسپیکشن کا نظام مضبوط بنانے کی ضرورت ہے۔

تقریب سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے کہا کہ محفوظ حالاتِ کار مزدوروں کی فلاح و بہبود کے لیے بنیادی حیثیت رکھتے ہیں۔ سندھ حکومت کے پاس پیشہ ورانہ تحفظ کے لیے جامع قانونی فریم ورک موجود ہے جس میں سندھ آکیوپیشنل سیفٹی اینڈ ہیلتھ ایکٹ 2017 بھی شامل ہے۔ بلدیہ فیکٹری اور بنگلا دیش کے رانا پلازا جیسے حوادث نے کام کی جگہوں پر مؤثر اقدامات کی اہمیت اجاگر کی۔

سعید غنی نے کہا کہ پاکستان ایکارڈ ٹیکسٹائل اور گارمنٹس کے شعبے میں کام کے معیار بہتر بنانے میں اہم کردار ادا کر رہا ہے، تاہم اس کا دائرہ زیادہ تر برآمدی فیکٹریوں تک محدود ہے۔ انہوں نے اس کے کامیاب طریقہ کار کو دیگر شعبوں تک بھی وسعت دینے پر زور دیا۔

عالمی برانڈز کی شرط مقامی صنعت کاروں کو تحفظ پر سرمایہ کاری کی ترغیب دیتی ہے، اور سندھ حکومت اس کی مکمل حمایت کرتی ہے۔ اس تقریب سے سیکرٹری محنت ساجد جمال ابڑو، سید ذوالفقار شاہ، سید نذیر علی اور دیگر نے بھی خطاب کیا۔

stories.title: US Treasuries Rally as Projected Democratic Control Suggests Government Spending Halt
stories.summary:
Treasury bonds experienced a significant rally as market participants predicted that a divided Congress, resulting from Democrats taking control, would lead to restricted government spending. Analysts noted that potential artificial intelligence regulations could also slow down economic growth and decrease the necessity for future interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve.

In Tokyo trade, benchmark 10-year Treasury yields dropped around 5 basis points to reach 4.90%, while 2-year yields declined slightly to touch a nearly two-month low of 4.5458%. Additionally, fed funds futures rose, lowering expectations regarding Federal Reserve rate increases in the upcoming year. Stock markets also slid, prompting investors to seek safety in bonds.

Market relief was further driven by the fading prospect of President Donald Trump’s prior pledge to distribute $5,000 to American adults if Republicans retained control of Congress. Andrew Lilley, chief rates strategist at Barrenjoey in Sydney, stated that while that promise represented a small tail risk, its removal prevented a cataclysmic reaction in Treasuries.

Lilley explained that a Republican president working alongside a Democratic-controlled Congress would likely frustrate spending initiatives and reduce overall expenditure. Meanwhile, lower yields exerted downward pressure on the US dollar, and concerns over an AI slowdown weighed on technology shares across Asia.

stories.title: کراچی میں ٹریلر کے ہولناک حادثات، نوجوان جاں بحق اور زخمی خاتون دم توڑ گئی
stories.summary:
کراچی میں ٹریلر کی ٹکر کے دو مختلف حادثات میں ایک نوجوان موقع پر جاں بحق ہوگیا جبکہ پہلے سے زخمی خاتون دورانِ علاج دم توڑ گئی۔ نیٹی جیٹی پل کے قریب پیش آنے والے حادثے میں موٹر سائیکل سوار 21 سالہ عبدالتواب جاں بحق ہوا۔ پولیس کے مطابق متوفی کا تعلق ہنگورہ آباد لیاری سے تھا اور اس کی لاش سول اسپتال منتقل کی گئی۔ حادثے کے بعد پولیس نے ٹریلر قبضے میں لے لیا جبکہ ڈرائیور فرار ہونے میں کامیاب ہوگیا جس کی تلاش جاری ہے۔

دوسرا واقعہ 26 اکتوبر کو کورنگی صنعتی ایریا تھانے کی حدود میں کورنگی جام صادق پل پر پیش آیا تھا، جہاں ٹریلر کی ٹکر سے شدید زخمی ہونے والی رافیعہ زوجہ وقار اسپتال میں دم توڑ گئی۔ اس المناک حادثے میں خاتون کی دونوں ٹانگیں ضائع ہو گئی تھیں جبکہ ان کا شوہر وقار موقع پر ہی جاں بحق ہو گیا تھا۔ حادثے کے بعد مشتعل شہریوں نے غصے میں آکر متعلقہ ٹریلر کو نذر آتش کر دیا تھا۔

ان دونوں حادثات نے شہر میں بھاری ٹریفک اور ٹریلروں کی غیر محتاط ڈرائیونگ کے مسائل کو ایک بار پھر نمایاں کر دیا ہے۔ پولیس اور انتظامیہ کی جانب سے ایسے حادثات کی روک تھام اور فرار ہونے والے ڈرائیوروں کی گرفتاری کے لیے قانونی کارروائیاں جاری ہیں۔

stories.title: Malaysian Palm Oil Drops to Mid-June Lows Amid Record Inventory Expectations
stories.summary:
Malaysian palm oil futures declined by more than one percent, reaching mid-June lows and extending losses into a third consecutive session. Market prices were pulled downward primarily by survey projections anticipating record-high domestic inventories, alongside weakening rival oils and declining crude petroleum prices.

During midday trading on the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange, the benchmark January delivery palm oil contract decreased by 55 ringgit, or 1.21%, settling at 4,496 ringgit, equivalent to $1,103.31 per metric ton. A Reuters survey indicated that Malaysia's palm oil stockpiles likely grew by 6.8% in October, moving from September's record 3.51 million tons to 3.75 million tons.

Negative sentiment was reinforced by overnight weakness in Dalian palm olein, pressured by falling crude palm oil futures. On the Dalian Commodity Exchange, the most-active soyoil contract dropped 1.6%, its palm oil contract fell 3.21%, and Chicago Board of Trade soyoil prices decreased by 1.46% as edible oils competed for global market share.

Simultaneously, crude oil prices slipped as investors awaited the outcomes of US midterm elections and potential implications for Middle Eastern peace talks. Weaker crude futures diminished the appeal of palm oil as a biodiesel feedstock, while a 0.12% strengthening of the ringgit against the dollar made the commodity costlier for foreign currency holders.

stories.title: Pakistan Offers Karachi Land to Turkish Businesses to Boost Trade Ties
stories.summary:
Pakistan has set aside 1,000 acres of land within the Karachi Industrial Park for Turkish enterprises as part of a broader government effort to draw foreign investment and enhance bilateral industrial cooperation. Commerce Minister Jam Kamal Khan announced the initiative during a meeting with Türkiye’s Trade Minister, Prof Ömer Bolat, in Istanbul.

The ministers met on the sidelines of the 42nd Session of the Standing Committee for Economic and Commercial Cooperation in Istanbul, where Jam Kamal invited Turkish companies to build industrial units and expand their manufacturing presence in Pakistan. Both officials reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening commercial ties and discussed agricultural export potentials, including Pakistani basmati rice and mangoes.

Prof Bolat emphasized the necessity of effective marketing and branding for Pakistani basmati rice inside Türkiye and assured full support for increasing imports of Pakistani mangoes. Furthermore, the Turkish Trade Minister agreed to dispatch a delegation of officials to Pakistan to review current bilateral trade mechanisms and investigate ways to improve economic relations.

In a separate meeting, Jam Kamal spoke with Zehra Zümrüt Selçuk, Director General of the Statistical, Economic and Social Research and Training Centre for Islamic Countries. The commerce minister stressed the significance of reliable data and evidence-based research in identifying trade trends and promoting economic integration among Organization of Islamic Cooperation member states.

stories.title: امریکی گلوکارہ آریانا گرانڈے کی سابق بوائے فرینڈ سے طویل عرصے بعد محبت بحال
stories.summary:
معروف امریکی گلوکارہ آریانا گرانڈے نے اپنے سابق بوائے فرینڈ رکی الواریز کے ساتھ رومانوی تصاویر سوشل میڈیا پر شیئر کر کے ایک بار پھر توجہ حاصل کر لی ہے۔ نیویارک میں گزارے گئے حسین لمحات کی ان تصاویر نے مداحوں کو دنگ کر دیا ہے جن میں دونوں ایک دوسرے کے لیے محبت کا اظہار کرتے دکھائی دے رہے ہیں۔

رپورٹس کے مطابق 33 سالہ گلوکارہ اور 35 سالہ رکی الواریز اس سے قبل سال 2015 سے 2016 کے دوران بھی باقاعدہ تعلق میں رہ چکے ہیں۔ تاہم باہمی علیحدگی کے تقریباً 10 سال بعد ان کی یہ پرانی محبت ایک بار پھر پروان چڑھی ہے جس کی تصدیق انہوں نے رواں سال اگست میں کی تھی۔

انسٹاگرام پر شیئر کی گئی تصاویر میں ایک موقع پر دونوں ایک دوسرے کی بانہوں میں نظر آئے جبکہ دوسری تصویر میں آریانا اپنے بوائے فرینڈ کی پیشانی چومتی دکھائی دیں۔ نجی زندگی کے حوالے سے سامنے آنے والی اس خبر پر ان کے چاہنے والے مختلف ردعمل کا اظہار کر رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: Mitchell Starc Claims Number One Test Bowling Ranking
stories.summary:
Australian fast bowler Mitchell Starc has advanced to the top of the International Cricket Council test bowling rankings. The 36-year-old athlete secured the leading position by overtaking South African all-rounder Marco Jansen.

Starc achieved this ranking after finishing as the leading wicket-taker in a recently concluded test series in South Africa. He collected a total of 15 wickets across three tests. Although Australia lost the final match and the series 2-1, Starc performed strongly in the last game with nine wickets, which included a first-innings performance of 6 for 72.

Jansen had previously reached the top spot in both the bowling and all-rounder rankings just a week earlier following a strong showing with bat and ball during the second test. However, his tenure at the summit was cut short by the Australian fast bowler's latest series output.

Additionally, South African spinner Simon Harmer climbed nine places to seventh in the standings. Harmer earned the Player of the Match award after claiming his maiden 10-wicket match haul in the third test against Australia.

stories.title: At Least Seven Muslims Win Election to US Congress
stories.summary:
At least seven Muslim lawmakers secured victories in the United States Congress during Tuesday's midterm elections. The results marked historic gains across both legislative chambers as candidates focused their campaigns on civil rights, healthcare, and foreign policy matters.

The elections altered the balance of power in Washington, with Democrats taking control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives from Republicans. Several returning and newly elected candidates ran on platforms addressing international legal standards, humanitarian aid, and opposition to unconditional US military support for Israel.

Notable winners include a 42-year-old Democratic candidate who became the first Muslim elected to the US Senate, a New Jersey plastic surgeon and Iraq War veteran who became the first Muslim to represent his state in Congress, and a civil rights investigator who won over 85 percent of the vote. Four incumbent House members—including prominent figures known for advocating Palestinian rights and arms oversight—also won reelection to two-year terms.

These victories come amidst wider debates on foreign policy and domestic civil rights. Meanwhile, vote counting continued for separate congressional races, with other Muslim candidates maintaining early leads in states such as California.

stories.title: Peshawar Teachers Protest Sudden Layoffs by UNHCR After Decades of Service
stories.summary:
Hundreds of Pakistani teachers gathered in Peshawar to protest their abrupt termination by the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees without any prior notice or financial compensation. A total of 291 educators, comprising 100 men and 191 women, were dismissed from their positions on October 31.

The affected teachers had spent 35 to 40 years educating Afghan children in refugee camps across multiple regions, including Peshawar, Mardan, Nowshera, Swabi, Kohat, and Bannu. Led by Tufail Ahmed and women's group head Farhana Durrani, the demonstrators demanded proper compensation and financial relief for their decades of dedicated service to the institution.

Protesters reported that they were sent home through a single administrative decision or phone call without receiving medical allowances, gratuity, or other financial benefits. They noted that the sudden loss of employment has plunged numerous families into severe financial distress, leaving them unable to cover basic household expenses.

Demonstrators complained that UNHCR officials refused to engage in dialogue, closed office doors, deployed police personnel outside, and warned participants of a potential baton charge. The protesters ultimately appealed to Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Governor Faisal Karim Kundi to intervene and secure financial relief for the dismissed educators and their dependents.

stories.title: Australian Shares Reach Lowest Close in Over a Week Due to Banks and Miners
stories.summary:
Australian shares declined on Wednesday, pushing the S&P/ASX 200 index down 0.6% to 8,834.50, marking its lowest closing level since October 26. This downturn was driven primarily by heavy losses in the mining and banking sectors as investors evaluated the broader economic impact of high interest rates.

The market reaction followed a decision by the Reserve Bank of Australia to increase its cash rate to an 18-year high of 4.85% in a split vote while removing its reference to potential future hikes. Bell Direct senior market analyst Grady Wulff noted that while the market shows cautious optimism regarding peak interest rates, investors remain selective due to slowing economic growth and a data-dependent central bank environment.

Sector performance showed financials recovering most of their losses to finish down 0.2%, influenced by a 0.6% drop in the Commonwealth Bank of Australia. Consumer-reliant discretionary and real estate sectors fell by 0.7% and 1.1% respectively, while miners extended their losing streak to five sessions with a 1.3% decline as copper hovered near 11-week lows. Major mining firms BHP and Rio Tinto dropped 1.5% and 1.7%.

Across the Tasman Sea, New Zealand's S&P/NZX 50 index rose 0.5% to close at 13,783.45. Labor market data released prior to a tight election showed quarterly unemployment climbing to an 11-year high, which Westpac NZ chief economist Kelly Eckhold suggested would support Monetary Policy Committee doves advocating for an upcoming pause in rate increases.

stories.title: Democrats Capture Control of Congress in Midterm Elections Marking Rebuke to Trump
stories.summary:
Democratic candidates secured majorities in both the Senate and the House of Representatives on Tuesday, achieving sweeping victories across traditional Republican strongholds in the midterm elections. Voters expressed widespread frustration with President Donald Trump's management of the economy and his February decision to launch a war against Iran, which caused sharp increases in gas prices.

The Democratic wave crossed into deeply conservative states, resulting in historic upsets. In Kansas, Adam Hamilton became the first Democrat to win a Senate seat since the Great Depression. Other notable Democratic victories included Sherrod Brown claiming a Senate seat in Ohio, state Representative James Talarico winning in Texas, and pediatrician Annie Andrews defeating Republican Senator Darline Graham in South Carolina. President Trump had campaigned heavily for several Republican candidates, repeatedly urging supporters to treat him as if he were on the ballot.

In addition to congressional gains, Democrats captured key governorships, including wins by Gina Hinojosa over three-term incumbent Texas Governor Greg Abbott, alongside victories in Iowa and Ohio. Exit polls conducted by SSRS revealed that half of nationwide voters viewed the 2026 midterms as a chance to rebuke the president, three-quarters reported feeling angry or dissatisfied with national direction, and 70% stated they desire increased congressional checks and balances.

Despite the scale of the Democratic gains, some races remained tight, such as Florida where Republican Senator Ashley Moody fended off Democrat Angie Nixon by about three percentage points. The shift in power carried profound political implications, demonstrating significant movement toward Democrats even in solidly conservative states.

stories.title: Saudi Civil Defence Confirms Danger Has Passed in Najran
stories.summary:
Saudi Arabia’s Civil Defence announced on Wednesday that the danger had passed in the southwestern province of Najran following an earlier alert warning of potential danger. Via social media platform X, authorities urged residents to continue following safety instructions and to avoid gathering and filming.

This announcement followed a second early warning issued for Najran on the same day. Earlier, Saudi authorities had similarly issued and lifted a potential danger alert for Riyadh province, instructing citizens to adhere to Civil Defence guidelines.

The domestic alerts occurred alongside regional developments in neighboring Yemen, where Al-Jumhuriya TV reported that four airstrikes targeted Houthi weapons depots and military vehicles at the Central Security Camp in Al-Bayda province. Broadcasters also reported on clashes, shelling, and military operations across Al-Dhalea, Taiz, Marib, and Lahj provinces.

Conflict in Yemen has persisted following a resumption of fighting in July, which followed a period of relative calm beginning in April 2022. The renewed hostilities have caused thousands of casualties and displaced over 250,000 individuals, deepening the nation's ongoing humanitarian crisis.

stories.title: JUI-F Chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman Hints at Street Agitation Against Government Policies
stories.summary:
Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rahman warned on Tuesday that his party would initiate street agitation if the government continues its current policies. Speaking at a workers convention in Mansehra, where former PPP Hazara divisional president Malik Waheed joined JUI-F, Rahman stated that his party would actively oppose any attempts by the government to plunder natural resources and undermine democratic rights.

Rahman criticized successive administrations for their handling of national security and counterterrorism, noting that despite billions of dollars in funding and 13 military operations since 2010, militancy has only increased while innocent citizens lose their lives.
